1.1: These are the words which Moses has spoken to all Israel, beyond the Jordan, in the wilderness, in the plain over-against Suph, between Paran and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-Zahab;
1.2: eleven days' from Horeb, the way of mount Seir, to Kadesh-Barnea.
1.3: And it comes to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month has Moses spoken to the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah has commanded him concerning them;
1.4: after his smiting Sihon king of the Amorite who is dwelling in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan who is dwelling in Ashtaroth in Edrei,
1.5: beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, has Moses begun to explain this law, saying:
1.6: `Jehovah our God has spoken to us in Horeb, saying, Enough to you--of dwelling in this mount;
1.7: turn you and journey for you, and enter the mount of the Amorite, and to all its neighbouring places, in the plain, in the hill-country, and in the low country, and in the south, and in the haven of the sea, the land of the Canaanite, and of Lebanon, to the great river, the river Phrat;
1.8: see, I have set before you the land; go in and possess the land which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them, and to their seed after them.
1.9: `And I speak to you at that time, saying, I am not able by myself to bear you;
1.10: Jehovah your God has multiplied you, and indeed, you are to-day as the stars of the heavens for multitude;
1.11: Jehovah, God of your fathers, is adding to you, as you are, a thousand times, and does bless you as He has spoken to you.
1.12: `How do I bear by myself your pressure, and your burden, and your strife?
1.13: Give for yourselves men, wise and intelligent, and known to your tribes, and I set them for your heads;
1.14: and you answer me and say, Good is the thing which you have spoken--to do.
1.15: `And I take the heads of your tribes, men, wise and known, and I appoint them heads over you, princes of thousands, and princes of hundreds, and princes of fifties, and princes of tens, and authorities, for your tribes.
1.16: And I command your judges at that time, saying, Hearkening between your brethren--then you have judged righteousness between a man, and his brother, and his sojourner;
1.17: you do not discern faces in judgment; as the little so the great you do hear; you are not afraid of the face of any, for the judgment is God's, and the thing which is too hard for you, you bring near to me, and I have heard it;
1.18: and I command you, at that time, all the things which you do.
1.19: `And we journey from Horeb, and go through all that great and fearful wilderness which you have seen--the way of the hill-country of the Amorite, as Jehovah our God has commanded us, and we come in to Kadesh-Barnea.
1.20: `And I say to you, You have come in to the hill-country of the Amorite, which Jehovah our God is giving to us;
1.21: see, Jehovah your God has set before you the land; go up, possess, as Jehovah, God of your fathers, has spoken to you; fear not, nor be affrighted.
1.22: `And you come near to me, all of you, and say, Let us send men before us, and they search for us the land, and they bring us back word concerning the way in which we go up into it, and the cities to which we come in;
1.23: and the thing is good in my eyes, and I take of you twelve men, one man for a tribe.
1.24: `And they turn and go up to the hill-country, and come in to the valley of Eshcol, and spy it,
1.25: and they take with their hand of the fruit of the land, and bring down to us, and bring us back word, and say, Good is the land which Jehovah our God is giving to us.
1.26: `And you have not been willing to go up, and you provoke the mouth of Jehovah your God,
1.27: and murmur in your tents, and say, In Jehovah's hating us He has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorite--to destroy us;
1.28: where are we going up? our brethren have melted our heart, saying, A people greater and taller than we, cities great and fenced to heaven, and also sons of Anakim--we have seen there.
1.29: `And I say to you, Be not terrified, nor be afraid of them;
1.30: Jehovah your God, who is going before you--He does fight for you, according to all that He has done with you in Egypt before your eyes,
1.31: and in the wilderness, where you have seen that Jehovah your God has borne you as a man bears his son, in all the way which you have gone, till your coming in to this place.
1.32: `And in this thing you are not stedfast in Jehovah your God,
1.33: who is going before you in the way to search out to you a place for your encamping, in fire by night, to show you in the way in which you go, and in a cloud by day.
1.34: `And Jehovah hears the voice of your words, and is wroth, and swears, saying,
1.35: Not one of these men of this evil generation does see the good land which I have sworn to give to your fathers,
1.36: save Caleb son of Jephunneh--he does see it, and to him I give the land on which he has trodden, and to his sons, because that he has been fully after Jehovah.
1.37: `Also with me has Jehovah been angry for your sake, saying, Also, you do not go in there;
1.38: Joshua son of Nun, who is standing before you, he goes in there; him strengthen you; for he does cause Israel to inherit.
1.39: `And your infants, of whom you have said, For a prey they are, and your sons who have not known to-day good and evil, they go in there, and to them I give it, and they possess it;
1.40: and you, turn for yourselves, and journey toward the wilderness, the way of the Red Sea.
1.41: `And you answer and say to me, We have sinned against Jehovah; we--we go up, and we have fought, according to all that which Jehovah our God has commanded us; and you gird on each his weapons of war, and you are ready to go up into the hill-country;
1.42: and Jehovah says to me, Say to them, You do not go up, nor fight, for I am not in your midst, and you are not smitten before your enemies.
1.43: `And I speak to you, and you have not hearkened, and provoke the mouth of Jehovah, and act proudly, and go up into the hill-country;
1.44: and the Amorite who is dwelling in that hill-country comes out to meet you, and they pursue you as the bees do, and smite you in Seir--to Hormah.
1.45: `And you turn back and weep before Jehovah, and Jehovah has not hearkened to your voice, nor has he given ear to you;
1.46: and you dwell in Kadesh many days, according to the days which you had dwelt.

2.1: `And we turn, and journey into the wilderness, the way of the Red Sea, as Jehovah has spoken to me, and we go round the mount of Seir many days.
2.3: Enough to you--is the going round of this mount; turn for yourselves northward.
2.4: `And the people command you, saying, You are passing over into the border of your brethren, sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, and they are afraid of you; and you have been very watchful,
2.5: you do not strive with them, for I do not give to you of their land even the treading of the sole of a foot; for a possession to Esau I have given mount Seir.
2.6: `Food you buy from them with money, and have eaten; and also water you buy from them with money, and have drunk,
2.7: for Jehovah your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands; He has known your walking in this great wilderness these forty years; Jehovah your God is with you; you have not lacked anything.
2.8: `And we pass by from our brethren, sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, by the way of the plain, by Elath, and by Ezion-Gaber; and we turn, and pass over the way of the wilderness of Moab;
2.9: and Jehovah says to me, Do not distress Moab, nor stir yourself up against them in battle, for I do not give to you of their land for a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given Ar for a possession.'
2.10: `The Emim formerly have dwelt in it, a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim;
2.11: Rephaim they are reckoned, they also, as the Anakim; and the Moabites call them Emim.
2.12: And in Seir have the Horim dwelt formerly; and the sons of Esau dispossess them, and destroy them from before them, and dwell in their stead, as Israel has done to the land of his possession, which Jehovah has given to them;
2.13: now, rise you, and pass over for yourselves the brook Zered; and we pass over the brook Zered.
2.14: `And the days which we have walked from Kadesh-Barnea until that we have passed over the brook Zered, are thirty and eight years, till the consumption of all the generation of the men of battle from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah has sworn to them;
2.15: and also the hand of Jehovah has been against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, till they are consumed.
2.16: `And it comes to pass, when all the men of battle have finished dying from the midst of the people,
2.17: that Jehovah speaks to me, saying,
2.18: You are passing over to-day the border of Moab, even Ar,
2.19: and you have come near over-against the sons of Ammon, you do not distress them, nor stir up yourself against them, for I do not give any of the land of the sons of Ammon to you for a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given it for a possession.
2.20: `A land of Rephaim it is reckoned, even it; Rephaim dwelt in it formerly, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim;
2.21: a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim, and Jehovah destroys them before them, and they dispossess them, and dwell in their stead,
2.22: as He has done for the sons of Esau, who are dwelling in Seir, when He destroyed the Horim from before them, and they dispossess them, and dwell in their stead, to this day.
2.23: `As to the Avim who are dwelling in Hazerim to Azzah, the Caphtorim--who are coming out from Caphtor--have destroyed them, and dwell in their stead.
2.24: `Rise you, journey and pass over the brook Arnon; see, I have given into your hand Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land; begin to possess, and stir up yourself against him in battle.
2.25: This day I begin to put your dread and your fear on the face of the peoples under the whole heavens, who hear your fame, and have trembled and been pained because of you.
2.26: `And I send messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth, to Sihon king of Heshbon, --words of peace--saying,
2.27: Let me pass over through your land; in the several ways I go; I turn not aside--right or left--
2.28: food for money you do sell me, and I have eaten; and water for money you do give to me, and I have drunk; only, let me pass over on my feet, --
2.29: as the sons of Esau who are dwelling in Seir, and the Moabites who are dwelling in Ar, have done to me--till that I pass over the Jordan, to the land which Jehovah our God is giving to us.
2.30: `And Sihon king of Heshbon has not been willing to let us pass over by him, for Jehovah your God has hardened his spirit, and strengthened his heart, so as to give him into your hand as at this day.
2.31: `And Jehovah says to me, See, I have begun to give before you Sihon and his land; begin to possess--to possess his land.
2.32: `And Sihon comes out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle to Jahaz;
2.33: and Jehovah our God gives him before us, and we smite him, and his sons, and all his people;
2.34: and we capture all his cities at that time, and devote the whole city, men, and the women, and the infants--we have not left a remnant;
2.35: only, the cattle we have spoiled for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we have captured.
2.36: `From Aroer, which is by the edge of the brook Arnon, and the city which is by the brook, even to Gilead there has not been a city which is too high for us; the whole has Jehovah our God given before us.
2.37: `Only, to the land of the sons of Ammon you have not drawn near, any part of the brook Jabbok, and cities of the hill-country, and anything which Jehovah our God has not commanded.

3.1: `And we turn, and go up the way to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan comes out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle, to Edrei.
3.2: `And Jehovah says to me, Fear him not, for into your hand I have given him, and all his people, and his land, and you have done to him as you have done to Sihon king of the Amorite who is dwelling in Heshbon.
3.3: `And Jehovah our God gives into our hands also Og king of Bashan, and all his people, and we smite him till there has not been left to him a remnant;
3.4: and we capture all his cities at that time, there has not been a city which we have not taken from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
3.5: All these are cities fenced with high walls, two-leaved doors and bar, apart from cities of villages very many;
3.6: and we devote them, as we have done to Sihon king of Heshbon, devoting every city, men, the women, and the infants;
3.7: and all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we have spoiled for ourselves.
3.8: `And we take, at that time, the land out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorite, which is beyond the Jordan, from the brook Arnon to mount Hermon;
3.9: (Sidonians call Hermon, Sirion; and the Amorites call it Senir,)
3.10: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,
3.11: for only Og king of Bashan had been left of the remnant of the Rephaim; indeed, his bedstead is a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? nine cubits its length, and four cubits its breadth, by the cubit of a man.
3.12: `And this land we have possessed, at that time; from Aroer, which is by the brook Arnon, and the half of mount Gilead, and its cities, I have given to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite;
3.13: and the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I have given to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, to all that Bashan, called the land of Rephaim.
3.14: `Jair son of Manasseh has taken all the region of Argob, to the border of Geshuri, and Maachathi, and calls them by his own name, Bashan-Havoth-Jair, to this day.
3.15: And to Machir I have given Gilead.
3.16: `And to the Reubenite and to the Gadite I have given from Gilead even to the brook Arnon, the middle of the valley and the border, even to Jabbok the brook, the border of the sons of Ammon,
3.17: and the plain, and the Jordan, and the border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the plain, the salt sea, under the springs of Pisgah, at the sun -rising.
3.18: `And I command you, at that time, saying, Jehovah your God has given to you this land to possess it; armed you pass over before your brethren the sons of Israel, all the sons of might.
3.19: Only, your wives, and your infants, and your cattle--I have known that you have much cattle--do dwell in your cities which I have given to you,
3.20: till that Jehovah give rest to your brethren like yourselves, and they also have possessed the land which Jehovah your God is giving to them beyond the Jordan, then you have turned back each to his possession, which I have given to you.
3.21: `And Jehoshua I have commanded at that time, saying, Your eyes are seeing all that which Jehovah your God has done to these two kings--so does Jehovah to all the kingdoms where you are passing over;
3.22: fear them not, for Jehovah your God, He is fighting for you.
3.23: `And I entreat for grace to Jehovah, at that time, saying,
3.24: Lord Jehovah, You--You have begun to show Your servant Your greatness, and Your strong hand; for who is a God in the heavens or in earth who does according to Your works, and according to Your might?
3.25: Let me pass over, I pray You, and see the good land which is beyond the Jordan, this good hill-country, and Lebanon.
3.26: `And Jehovah shows himself wroth with me, for your sake, and has not hearkened to me, and Jehovah says to me, Enough for you; add not to speak to Me any more about this thing:
3.27: go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes--for you do not pass over this Jordan;
3.28: and charge Jehoshua, and strengthen him, and harden him, for he does pass over before this people, and he does cause them to inherit the land which you see.
3.29: `And we dwell in a valley over-against Beth-Peor.

4.1: `And now, Israel, hearken to the statutes, and to the judgments which I am teaching you to do, so that you live, and have gone in, and possessed the land which Jehovah God of your fathers is giving to you.
4.2: You do not add to the word which I am commanding you, nor diminish from it, to keep the commands of Jehovah your God which I am commanding you.
4.3: `Your eyes are seeing that which Jehovah has done in Baal-Peor, for every man who has gone after Baal-Peor, Jehovah your God has destroyed him from your midst;
4.4: and you who are cleaving to Jehovah your God, are alive, all of you, to-day.
4.5: `See, I have taught you statutes and judgments, as Jehovah my God has commanded me--to do so, in the midst of the land where you are going in to possess it;
4.6: and you have kept and done them (for it is your wisdom and your understanding) before the eyes of the peoples who hear all these statutes, and they have said, Only, a people wise and understanding is this great nation.
4.7: `For which is the great nation that has God near to it, as Jehovah our God, in all we have called to him?
4.8: and which is the great nation which has righteous statutes and judgments according to all this law which I am setting before you to-day?
4.9: `Only, take heed to yourself, and watch your soul exceedingly, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they turn aside from your heart, all days of your life; and you have made them known to your sons, and to your sons' sons.
4.10: `The day when you have stood before Jehovah your God in Horeb--in Jehovah's saying to me, Assemble to Me the people, and I cause them to hear My words, so that they learn to fear Me all the days that they are alive on the ground, and their sons they teach; --
4.11: and you draw near and stand under the mountain, and the mountain is burning with fire to the heart of the heavens--darkness, cloud, yes, thick darkness:
4.12: `And Jehovah speaks to you out of the midst of the fire; a voice of words you are hearing and a similitude you are not seeing, only a voice;
4.13: and He declares to you His covenant, which He has commanded you to do, the Ten Matters, and He writes them upon two tables of stone.
4.14: `And me has Jehovah commanded at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, for your doing them in the land where you are passing over to possess it;
4.15: and you have been very watchful of your souls, for you have not seen any similitude in the day of Jehovah's speaking to you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire,
4.16: lest you do corruptly, and have made to you a graven image, a similitude of any figure, a form of male or female--
4.17: a form of any beast which is in the earth--a form of any winged bird which flies in the heavens--
4.18: a form of any creeping thing on the ground--a form of any fish which is in the waters under the earth;
4.19: `And lest you lift up your eyes toward the heavens, and have seen the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of the heavens, and you have been forced, and have bowed yourself to them, and served them, which Jehovah your God has apportioned to all the peoples under the whole heavens.
4.20: `And you has Jehovah taken, and He is bringing you out from the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be to Him for a people--an inheritance, as at this day.
4.21: `And Jehovah has showed himself wroth with me because of your words, and swears to my not passing over the Jordan, and to my not going in to the good land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance;
4.22: for I am dying in this land; I am not passing over the Jordan, and you are passing over, and have possessed this good land.
4.23: `Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, which He has made with you, and have made to yourselves a graven image, a similitude of anything concerning which Jehovah your God has charged you:
4.24: for Jehovah your God is a fire consuming--a zealous God.
4.25: `When you beget sons and sons' sons, and you have become old in the land, and have done corruptly, and have made a graven image, a similitude of anything, and have done the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to provoke Him to anger: --
4.26: I have caused to testify against you this day the heavens and the earth, that you do perish utterly hastily from off the land where you are passing over the Jordan to possess it; you do not prolong days upon it, but are utterly destroyed;
4.27: and Jehovah has scattered you among the peoples, and you have been left few in number among the nations, where Jehovah leads you,
4.28: and you have served there gods, work of man's hands, wood and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
4.29: `And--you have sought from from there Jehovah your God, and have found, when you seek Him with all your heart, and with all your soul,
4.30: in distress being to you, and all these things have found you, in the latter end of the days, and you have turned back to Jehovah your God, and have hearkened to His voice;
4.31: for a merciful God is Jehovah your God; He does not fail you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers, which He has sworn to them.
4.32: `For, ask, I pray you, at the former days which have been before you, from the day that God prepared man on the earth, and from the one end of the heavens even to the other end of the heavens, whether there has been as this great thing--or has been heard like it?
4.33: Has a people heard the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, you--and does live?
4.34: Or has God tried to go in to take to Himself, a nation from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great terrors--according to all that Jehovah your God has done to you, in Egypt, before your eyes?
4.35: You, you have been shown it, to know that Jehovah He is God; there is none else besides Him.
4.36: `From the heavens He has caused you to hear His voice, to instruct you, and on earth He has showed you His great fire, and His words you have heard out of the midst of the fire.
4.37: `And because that He has loved your fathers, He does also fix on their seed after them, and does bring you out, in His presence, by His great power, from Egypt:
4.38: to dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, from your presence, to bring you in to give to you their land--an inheritance, as at this day.
4.39: `And you have known to-day, and have turned it back to your heart, that Jehovah He is God, in the heavens above, and on the earth beneath--there is none else;
4.40: and you have kept His statutes and His commands which I am commanding you to-day, so that it is well to you, and to your sons after you, and so that you prolong days on the ground which Jehovah your God is giving to you--all the days.'
4.41: Then Moses separates three cities beyond the Jordan, toward the sun-rising,
4.42: for the fleeing there of the man-slayer, who slays his neighbour unknowingly, and he is not hating him heretofore, and he has fled to one of these cities, and he has lived:
4.43: Bezer, in the wilderness, in the land of the plain, of the Reubenite; and Ramoth, in Gilead, of the Gadite; and Golan, in Bashan, of the Manassahite.
4.44: And this is the law which Moses has set before the sons of Israel;
4.45: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses has spoken to the sons of Israel, in their coming out of Egypt,
4.46: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over-against Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorite, who is dwelling in Heshbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel have smitten, in their coming out of Egypt,
4.47: and they possess his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorite who are beyond the Jordan, toward the sun-rising;
4.48: from Aroer, which is by the edge of the brook Arnon, even to mount Sion, which is Hermon--
4.49: and all the plain beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

5.1: And Moses calls to all Israel, and says to them, `Hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments which I am speaking in your ears to-day, and you have learned them, and have observed to do them.
5.2: Jehovah our God made with us a covenant in Horeb;
5.3: not with our fathers has Jehovah made this covenant, but with us; we--these--here to-day--all of us alive.
5.4: Face to face has Jehovah spoken with you, in the mount, out of the midst of the fire;
5.5: I am standing between Jehovah and you, at that time, to declare to you the word of Jehovah, for you have been afraid from the presence of the fire, and you have not gone up into the mount; saying:
5.6: `I Jehovah am your God, who has brought you out from the land of Egypt, from a house of servants.
5.7: `You have no other gods in My presence.
5.8: `You do not make to you a graven image, any similitude which is in the heavens above, and which is in the earth beneath, and which is in the waters under the earth;
5.9: you do not bow yourself to them nor serve them, for I Jehovah your God am a zealous God, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on a third generation, and on a fourth, to those hating Me;
5.10: and doing kindness to thousands, to those loving Me, and to those keeping My commands.
5.11: `You do not take up the Name of Jehovah your God for a vain thing, for Jehovah does not acquit him who takes up His Name for a vain thing.
5.12: `Observe the day of the sabbath--to sanctify it, as Jehovah your God has commanded you;
5.13: six days you do labour, and have done all your work,
5.14: and the seventh day is a sabbath to Jehovah your God; you do not do any work, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your man-servant, and your handmaid, and your ox, and your ass, and all your cattle, and your sojourner who is within your gates; so that your man-servant, and your handmaid does rest like yourself;
5.15: and you have remembered that a servant you have been in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah your God is bringing you out from there by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm; therefore has Jehovah your God commanded you to keep the day of the sabbath.
5.16: `Honour your father and your mother, as Jehovah your God has commanded you, so that your days are prolonged, and so that it is well with you, on the ground which Jehovah your God is giving to you.
5.20: `You do not answer against your neighbour--a false testimony.
5.21: `You do not desire your neighbour's wife; nor do you covet your neighbour's house, his field, and his man-servant, and his handmaid, his ox, and his ass, and anything which is your neighbour's.
5.22: `These words has Jehovah spoken to all your assembly, in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness--a great voice; and He has not added, and He writes them on two tables of stone, and gives them to me.
5.23: `And it comes to pass as you hear the voice out of the midst of the darkness, and of the mountain burning with fire, that you come near to me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders,
5.24: and say, Indeed, Jehovah our God has showed us His honour, and His greatness; and His voice we have heard out of the midst of the fire; this day we have seen that God does speak with man--and he has lived.
5.25: `And, now, why do we die? for consume us does this great fire--if we add to hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more--then we have died.
5.26: For who of all flesh is he who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire like us--and does live?
5.27: Draw near you, and hear all that which Jehovah our God says, and you, you do speak to us all that which Jehovah our God speaks to you, and we have hearkened, and done it.
5.28: `And Jehovah hears the voice of your words, in your speaking to me, and Jehovah says to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you; they have done well in all that they have spoken.
5.29: O that their heart had been thus to them, to fear Me, and to keep My commands all the days, that it may be well with them, and with their sons--to the age!
5.30: `Go, say to them, Turn back for yourselves, to your tents;
5.31: and you here stand you with Me, and let Me speak to you all the command, and the statutes, and the judgments which you do teach them, and they have done in the land which I am giving to them to possess it.
5.32: `And you have observed to do as Jehovah your God has commanded you, you turn not aside--right or left;
5.33: in all the way which Jehovah your God has commanded you you walk, so that you live, and it is well with you, and you have prolonged days in the land which you possess.

6.1: `And this is the command, the statutes and the judgments which Jehovah your God has commanded to teach you, to do in the land which you are passing over there to possess it,
6.2: so that you do fear Jehovah your God, to keep all His statutes and His commands, which I am commanding you, you, and your son, and your son's son, all days of your life, and so that your days are prolonged.
6.3: `And you have heard, O Israel, and observed to do, that it may be well with you, and that you may multiply exceedingly, as Jehovah, God of your fathers, has spoken to you, in the land flowing with milk and honey.
6.4: `Hear, O Israel, Jehovah our God is one Jehovah;
6.5: and you have loved Jehovah your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might,
6.6: and these words which I am commanding you to-day have been on your heart,
6.7: and you have repeated them to your sons, and spoken of them in your sitting in your house, and in your walking in the way, and in your lying down, and in your rising up,
6.8: and have bound them for a sign upon your hand, and they have been for frontlets between your eyes,
6.9: and you have written them on door-posts of your house, and on your gates.
6.10: `And it has been, when Jehovah your God does bring you in to the land which He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to you--cities great and good, which you have not built,
6.11: and houses full of all good things which you have not filled, and wells digged which you have not digged, vineyards and olive-yards which you have not planted, and you have eaten, and been satisfied;
6.12: `Take heed to yourself lest you forget Jehovah who has brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
6.13: Jehovah your God you do fear, and Him you do serve, and by His name you do swear;
6.14: you do not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are round about you;
6.15: for a zealous God is Jehovah your God in your midst--lest the anger of Jehovah your God burn against you, and He has destroyed you from off the face of the ground.
6.16: `You do not try Jehovah your God as you tried in Massah;
6.17: you do diligently keep the commands of Jehovah your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you,
6.18: and you have done that which is right and good in the eyes of Jehovah, so that it is well with you, and you have gone in and possessed the good land which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers,
6.19: to drive away all your enemies from your presence, as Jehovah has spoken.
6.20: `When your son asks you hereafter, saying, What are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Jehovah our God has commanded you?
6.21: then you have said to your son, Servants we have been to Pharaoh in Egypt, and Jehovah brings us out of Egypt by a high hand;
6.22: and Jehovah gives signs and wonders, great and sad, on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
6.23: and us He has brought out from there, in order to bring us in, to give to us the land which He had sworn to our fathers.
6.24: And Jehovah commands us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for good to ourselves all the days, to keep us alive, as at this day;
6.25: and righteousness it is for us, when we observe to do all this command before Jehovah our God, as He has commanded us.

7.1: `When Jehovah your God does bring you in to the land where you are going in to possess it, and He has cast out many nations from your presence, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations more numerous and mighty than you,
7.2: and Jehovah your God has given them before you, and you have smitten them--you do utterly devote them--you do not make with them a covenant, nor do you favour them.
7.3: `And you do not join in marriage with them; your daughter you do not give to his son, and his daughter you do not take to your son,
7.4: for he does turn aside your son from after Me, and they have served other gods, and the anger of Jehovah has burned against you, and has destroyed you hastily.
7.5: `But thus you do to them: their altars you break down, and their standing pillars you shiver, and their shrines you cut down, and their graven images you burn with fire;
7.6: for a holy people are you to Jehovah your God; on you has Jehovah your God fixed, to be to Him for a peculiar people, out of all the peoples who are on the face of the ground.
7.7: `Not because of your being more numerous than any of the peoples has Jehovah delighted in you, and fixes on you, for you are the least of all the peoples,
7.8: but because of Jehovah's loving you, and because of His keeping the oath which He has sworn to your fathers, has Jehovah brought you out by a strong hand, and does ransom you from a house of servants, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
7.9: `And you have known that Jehovah your God He is God, the faithful God, keeping the covenant, and the kindness, to those loving Him, and to those keeping His commands--to a thousand generations,
7.10: and repaying to those hating Him, to their face, to destroy them; He delays not to him who is hating Him--to his face, He repays to him--
7.11: and you have kept the command, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I am commanding you to-day to do them.
7.12: `And it has been, because you hear these judgments, and have kept, and done them, that Jehovah your God has kept to you the covenant and the kindness which He has sworn to your fathers,
7.13: and has loved you, and blessed you, and multiplied you, and has blessed the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your ground, your corn, and your new wine, and your oil, the increase of your oxen, and the wealth of your flock, on the ground which He has sworn to your fathers to give to you.
7.14: `Blessed are you above all the peoples, there is not in you a barren man or a barren woman--nor among your cattle;
7.15: and Jehovah has turned aside from you every sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt (which you have known) does He put on you, and He has put them on all hating you.
7.16: `And you have consumed all the peoples whom Jehovah your God is giving to you; your eye has no pity on them, and you do not serve their gods, for a snare it is to you.
7.17: `When you say in your heart, These nations are more numerous than I, how am I able to dispossess them? --
7.18: you are not afraid of them; you do surely remember that which Jehovah your God has done to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt,
7.19: the great trials which your eyes have seen, and the signs, and the wonders, and the strong hand, and the stretched-out arm, with which Jehovah your God has brought you out; so does Jehovah your God to all the peoples of whose presence you are afraid.
7.20: `And also the locust does Jehovah your God send among them, till the destruction of those who are left, and of those who are hidden from your presence;
7.21: you are not terrified by their presence, for Jehovah your God is in your midst, a God great and fearful.
7.22: `And Jehovah your God has cast out these nations from your presence little by little, (you are not able to consume them hastily, lest the beast of the field multiply against you),
7.23: and Jehovah your God has given them before you, and destroyed them--a great destruction--till their destruction;
7.24: and He has given their kings into your hand, and you have destroyed their name from under the heavens; no man does station himself in your presence till you have destroyed them.
7.25: `The graven images of their gods you do burn with fire; you do not desire the silver and gold on them, nor have you taken it to yourself, lest you be snared by it, for the abomination of Jehovah your God it is;
7.26: and you do not bring in an abomination to your house--or you have been devoted like it; --you do utterly detest it, and you do utterly abominate it; for it is devoted.

8.1: `All the command which I am commanding you to-day you observe to do, so that you live, and have multiplied, and gone in, and possessed the land which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers;
8.2: and you have remembered all the way which Jehovah your God has caused you to go these forty years in the wilderness, in order to humble you to try you, to know that which is in your heart, whether you do keep His commands or not.
8.3: `And He does humble you, and cause you to hunger and does cause you to eat the manna (which you have not known, even your fathers have not known), in order to cause you to know that not by bread alone does man live, but by every produce of the mouth of Jehovah man does live.
8.4: `Your raiment has not worn out from off you, and your foot has not swelled these forty years,
8.5: and you have known, with your heart, that as a man chastises his son Jehovah your God is chastising you,
8.6: and you have kept the commands of Jehovah your God, to walk in His ways, and to fear Him.
8.7: `For Jehovah your God is bringing you in to a good land, a land of brooks of waters, of fountains, and of depths coming out in valley and in mountain:
8.8: a land of wheat, and barley, and vine, and fig, and pomegranate; a land of oil olive and honey;
8.9: a land in which without scarcity you do eat bread, you do not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of its mountains you do dig brass;
8.10: and you have eaten, and been satisfied, and have blessed Jehovah your God, on the good land which he has given to you.
8.11: `Take heed to yourself, lest you forget Jehovah your God so as not to keep His commands, and His judgments, and His statutes which I am commanding you to-day;
8.12: lest you eat, and have been satisfied, and good houses do build, and have inhabited;
8.13: and your herd and your flock be multiplied, and silver and gold be multiplied to you; and all that is yours be multiplied:
8.14: `And your heart has been high, and you have forgotten Jehovah your God (who is bringing you out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
8.15: who is causing you to go in the great and the terrible wilderness--burning serpent, and scorpion, and thirst--where there is no water; who is bringing out to you waters from the flinty rock;
8.16: who is causing you to eat manna in the wilderness, which your fathers have not known, in order to humble you, and in order to try you, to do you good in your latter end),
8.17: and you have said in your heart, My power, and the might of my hand, has made for me this wealth:
8.18: `And you have remembered Jehovah your God, for He it is who is giving to you power to make wealth, in order to establish His covenant which He has sworn to your fathers as at this day.
8.19: `And it has been--if you really forget Jehovah your God, and have gone after other gods, and served them, and bowed yourself to them, I have testified against you to-day that you do utterly perish;
8.20: as the nations whom Jehovah is destroying from your presence, so you perish; because you hearken not to the voice of Jehovah your God.

9.1: `Hear, Israel, you are passing over to-day the Jordan, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than yourself; cities great and fenced in the heavens;
9.2: a people great and tall, sons of Anakim, whom you--you have known, (and you--you have heard: Who does station himself before sons of Anak?)
9.3: and you have known to-day, that Jehovah your God is He who is passing over before you--a fire consuming; He does destroy them, and He does humble them before you, and you have dispossessed them, and destroyed them hastily, as Jehovah has spoken to you.
9.4: `You do not speak in your heart (in Jehovah your God's driving them away from before you), saying, For my righteousness has Jehovah brought me in to possess this land, seeing for the wickedness of these nations is Jehovah dispossessing them from your presence;
9.5: not for your righteousness, and for the uprightness of your heart, are you going in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations is Jehovah your God dispossessing them from before you; and in order to establish the word which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob;
9.6: and you have known, that not for your righteousness is Jehovah your God giving to you this good land to possess it, for a people stiff of neck you are.
9.7: `Remember--do not forget--that with which you have made Jehovah your God wroth in the wilderness; even from the day that you have come out of the land of Egypt till your coming in to this place rebels you have been with Jehovah;
9.8: even in Horeb you have made Jehovah wroth, and Jehovah shows Himself angry against you--to destroy you.
9.9: `In my going up into the mount to receive the tables of stone (tables of the covenant which Jehovah has made with you), and I abide in the mount forty days and forty nights; bread I have not eaten, and water I have not drunk;
9.10: and Jehovah gives to me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God, and on them according to all the words which Jehovah has spoken with you in the mount, out of the midst of the fire, in the day of the assembly.
9.11: `And it comes to pass, at the end of forty days and forty nights, Jehovah has given to me the two tables of stone--tables of the covenant,
9.12: and Jehovah says to me, Rise, go down, hasten from this, for your people has done corruptly, whom you have brought out of Egypt; they have turned aside hastily out of the way which I have commanded them--they have made to themselves a molten thing!
9.13: `And Jehovah speaks to me, saying, I have seen this people, and indeed, a people stiff of neck it is;
9.14: desist from Me, and I destroy them, and blot out their name from under the heavens, and I make you become a nation more mighty and numerous than it.
9.15: `And I turn, and come down from the mount, and the mount is burning with fire, and the two tables of the covenant on my two hands,
9.16: and I see, and indeed, you have sinned against Jehovah your God; you have made to yourselves a molten calf; you have turned aside hastily out of the way which Jehovah has commanded you.
9.17: `And I lay hold on the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and break them before your eyes,
9.18: and I throw myself before Jehovah, as at first, forty days and forty nights; bread I have not eaten, and water I have not drunk, because of all your sins which you have sinned, by doing the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to make Him angry.
9.19: `For I have been afraid because of the anger and the fury with which Jehovah has been wroth against you, to destroy you; and Jehovah does hearken to me also at this time.
9.20: `And with Aaron has Jehovah showed himself very angry, to destroy him, and I pray also for Aaron at that time;
9.21: and your sin, which you have made--the calf--I have taken, and I burn it with fire, and beat it, grinding well till that it is small as dust, and I cast its dust to the brook which is going down out of the mount.
9.22: `And in Taberah, and in Massah, and in Kibroth-Hattaavah, you have been making Jehovah wroth:
9.23: and in Jehovah's sending you from Kadesh-Barnea, saying, Go up, and possess the land which I have given to you, then you provoke the mouth of Jehovah your God, and have not given credence to Him, nor hearkened to His voice;
9.24: rebels you have been with Jehovah from the day of my knowing you.
9.25: `And I throw myself before Jehovah, the forty days and the forty nights, as I had thrown myself, for Jehovah has said--to destroy you;
9.26: and I pray to Jehovah, and say, Lord Jehovah, destroy not Your people, and Your inheritance, whom You have ransomed in Your greatness; whom You have brought out of Egypt with a strong hand;
9.27: be mindful of Your servants, of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, turn not to the stiffness of this people, and to its wickedness, and to its sin;
9.28: lest the land say from which You have brought us out, Because of Jehovah's want of ability to bring them in to the land of which He has spoken to them, and because of His hating them, He brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness;
9.29: and they are Your people, and Your inheritance, whom You have brought out by Your great power, and by Your stretched-out arm!

10.1: `At that time has Jehovah said to me, Grave for you two tables of stone, like the first, and come up to Me, into the mount, and you have made for you an ark of wood,
10.2: and I write on the tables the words which were on the first tables, which you have broken, and you have placed them in the ark;
10.3: and I make an ark of shittim wood, and grave two tables of stone like the first, and go up to the mount, and the two tables in my hand.
10.4: `And He writes on the tables, according to the first writing, the Ten Matters, which Jehovah has spoken to you in the mount, out of the midst of the fire, in the day of the assembly, and Jehovah gives them to me,
10.5: and I turn and come down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made, and they are there, as Jehovah commanded me.
10.6: `And the sons of Israel have journeyed from Beeroth of the sons of Jaakan to Mosera, there Aaron died, and he is buried there, and Eleazar his son does act as priest in his stead;
10.7: from there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
10.8: `At that time has Jehovah separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, to stand before Jehovah, to serve Him, and to bless in His name, to this day,
10.9: therefore there has not been to Levi a portion and inheritance with his brethren; Jehovah Himself is his inheritance, as Jehovah your God has spoken to him.
10.10: `And I--I have stood in the mount, as the former days, forty days and forty nights, and Jehovah hearkens to me also at that time; Jehovah has not willed to destroy you.
10.11: `And Jehovah says to me, Rise, go to journey before the people, and they go in and possess the land which I have sworn to their fathers to give to them.
10.12: `And now, Israel, what is Jehovah your God asking from you, except to fear Jehovah your God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve Jehovah your God with all your heart, and with all your soul,
10.13: to keep the commands of Jehovah, and His statutes which I am commanding you to-day, for good to you?
10.14: `Indeed, to Jehovah your God are the heavens and the heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that is in it;
10.15: only in your fathers has Jehovah delighted--to love them, and He does fix on their seed after them--on you, out of all the peoples as at this day;
10.16: and you have circumcised the foreskin of your heart, and your neck you do not harden any more;
10.17: for Jehovah your God--He is God of the gods, and Lord of the lords; God, the great, the mighty, and the fearful; who accepts not persons, nor takes a bribe;
10.18: He is doing the judgment of fatherless and widow, and loving the sojourner, to give to him bread and raiment.
10.19: `And you have loved the sojourner, for sojourners you were in the land of Egypt.
10.20: `Jehovah your God you do fear, Him you do serve, and to Him you do cleave, and by His name you do swear.
10.21: He is your praise, and He is your God, who has done with you these great and fearful things which your eyes have seen:
10.22: with seventy persons did your fathers go down to Egypt, and now has Jehovah your God made you as stars of the heavens for multitude.

11.1: `And you have loved Jehovah your God, and kept His charge, and His statutes, and His judgments, and His commands, all the days;
11.2: and you have known to-day--for it is not your sons who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, His greatness, His strong hand, and His stretched-out arm,
11.3: and His signs, and His doings, which He has done in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to all his land;
11.4: and that which He has done to the force of Egypt, to its horses, and to its chariot, when He has caused the waters of the Red Sea to flow against their faces in their pursuing after them, and Jehovah destroys them, to this day;
11.5: and that which He has done to you in the wilderness, till your coming in to this place;
11.6: and that which He has done to Dathan, and to Abiram, sons of Eliab, sons of Reuben, when the earth has opened her mouth and swallows them, and their houses, and their tents, and all that lives, which is at their feet, in the midst of all Israel:
11.7: `--But it is your eyes which are seeing all the great work of Jehovah, which He has done;
11.8: and you have kept all the command which I am commanding you to-day, so that you are strong, and have gone in, and possessed the land where you are passing over to possess it,
11.9: and so that you prolong days on the ground which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers to give to them and to their seed--a land flowing with milk and honey.
11.10: `For the land where you are going in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt from where you have come out, where you sow your seed, and have watered with your foot, as a garden of the green herb;
11.11: but the land where you are passing over to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys; of the rain of the heavens it drinks water;
11.12: a land which Jehovah your God is searching; continually are the eyes of Jehovah your God upon it, from the beginning of the year even to the latter end of the year.
11.13: `And it has been--if you hearken diligently to My commands which I am commanding you to-day, to love Jehovah your God, and to serve Him with all your heart, and with all your soul--
11.14: that I have given the rain of your land in its season--sprinkling and gathered--and you have gathered your corn, and your new wine, and your oil,
11.15: and I have given herbs in your field for your cattle, and you have eaten, and been satisfied.
11.16: `Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be enticed, and you have turned aside, and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them,
11.17: and the anger of Jehovah has burned against you, and He has restrained the heavens, and there is no rain, and the ground does not give her increase, and you have perished hastily from off the good land which Jehovah is giving to you.
11.18: `And you have placed these my words on your heart, and on your soul, and have bound them for a sign on your hand, and they have been for frontlets between your eyes;
11.19: and you have taught them to your sons, by speaking of them in your sitting in your house, and in your going in the way, and in your lying down, and in your rising up,
11.20: and have written them on the side-posts of your house, and on your gates,
11.21: so that your days are multiplied, and the days of your sons, on the ground which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens on the earth.
11.22: `For, if you diligently keep all this command which I am commanding you--to do it, to love Jehovah your God, to walk in all His ways, and to cleave to Him,
11.23: then has Jehovah dispossessed all these nations from before you, and you have possessed nations, greater and mightier than you;
11.24: every place on which the sole of your foot treads is yours; from the wilderness, and Lebanon, from the river, the river Phrat, even to the farther sea is your border;
11.25: no man does station himself in your presence; your dread and your fear does Jehovah your God put on the face of all the land on which you tread, as He has spoken to you.
11.26: `See, I am setting before you to-day a blessing and a reviling:
11.27: the blessing, when you hearken to the commands of Jehovah your God, which I am commanding you to-day;
11.28: and the reviling, if you do not hearken to the commands of Jehovah your God, and have turned aside out of the way which I am commanding you to-day, to go after other gods which you have not known.
11.29: `And it has been, when Jehovah your God does bring you in to the land where you are going in to possess it, that you have given the blessing on mount Gerizim, and the reviling on mount Ebal;
11.30: are they not beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going in of the sun, in the land of the Canaanite, who is dwelling in the plain over-against Gilgal, near the oaks of Moreh?
11.31: for you are passing over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you; and you have possessed it, and dwelt in it,
11.32: and observed to do all the statutes and the judgments which I am setting before you to day.

12.1: `These are the statutes and the judgments which you observe to do in the land which Jehovah, God of your fathers, has given to you to possess it, all the days that you are living on the ground:
12.2: you do utterly destroy all the places where the nations which you are dispossessing served their gods, on the high mountains, and on the heights, and under every green tree;
12.3: and you have broken down their altars, and shivered their standing pillars, and their shrines you burn with fire, and graven images of their gods you cut down, and have destroyed their name out of that place.
12.4: `You do not do so to Jehovah your God;
12.5: but to the place which Jehovah your God does choose out of all your tribes to put His name there, to His tabernacle you seek, and you have entered there,
12.6: and have brought in there your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and your vows, and your free-will offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock;
12.7: and you have eaten there before Jehovah your God, and have rejoiced in every putting forth of your hand, you and your households, with which Jehovah your God has blessed you.
12.8: `You do not do according to all that we are doing here to-day, each anything that is right in his own eyes,
12.9: for you have not come in hitherto to the rest, and to the inheritance, which Jehovah your God is giving to you;
12.10: and you have passed over the Jordan, and have dwelt in the land which Jehovah your God is causing you to inherit, and He has given rest to you from all your enemies round about, and you have dwelt confidently:
12.11: `And it has been, the place on which Jehovah your God does fix to cause His name to tabernacle there, there you bring in all that which I am commanding you, your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and all the choice of your vows which you vow to Jehovah;
12.12: and you have rejoiced before Jehovah your God, you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants, and your handmaids, and the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no part and inheritance with you.
12.13: `Take heed to you, lest you cause your burnt-offerings to ascend in any place which you see,
12.14: except in the place which Jehovah does choose in one of your tribes, there you do cause your burnt-offerings to ascend, and there you do do all that which I am commanding you.
12.15: `Only, with all the desire of your soul you do sacrifice, and have eaten flesh according to the blessing of Jehovah your God which He has given to you, in all your gates; the unclean and the clean do eat it, as of the roe, and as of the hart.
12.16: `Only, the blood you do not eat--on the earth you do pour it as water;
12.17: you are not able to eat within your gates the tithe of your corn, and of your new wine, and your oil, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock, and any of your vows which you vow, and your free-will offerings, and heave-offering of your hand;
12.18: but before Jehovah your God you do eat it, in the place which Jehovah your God does fix on, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your man-servant, and your handmaid, and the Levite who is within your gates, and you have rejoiced before Jehovah your God in every putting forth of your hand;
12.19: take heed to you lest you forsake the Levite all your days on your ground.
12.20: `When Jehovah your God does enlarge your border, as He has spoken to you, and you have said, Let me eat flesh--for your soul desires to eat flesh--of all the desire of your soul you do eat flesh.
12.21: `When the place is far from you which Jehovah your God does choose to put His name there, then you have sacrificed of your herd and of your flock which Jehovah has given to you, as I have commanded you, and have eaten within your gates, of all the desire of your soul;
12.22: only, as the roe and the hart is eaten, so do you eat it; the unclean and the clean does alike eat it.
12.23: `Only, be sure not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you do not eat the life with the flesh;
12.24: you do not eat it, on the earth you do pour it as water;
12.25: you do not eat it, in order that it may be well with you, and with your sons after you, when you do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah.
12.26: `Only, your holy things which you have, and your vows, you do take up, and have gone in to the place which Jehovah does choose,
12.27: and you have made your burnt-offerings--the flesh and the blood--on the altar of Jehovah your God; and the blood of your sacrifices is poured out by the altar of Jehovah your God, and the flesh you do eat.
12.28: Observe, and you have obeyed all these words which I am commanding you, in order that it may be well with you and with your sons after you--to the age, when you do that which is good and right in the eyes of Jehovah your God.
12.29: `When Jehovah your God does cut off the nations--where you are going in to possess them--from your presence, and you have possessed them, and have dwelt in their land--
12.30: take heed to you, lest you be snared after them, after their being destroyed out of your presence, and lest you enquire about their gods, saying, How do these nations serve their gods, and I do so--even I?
12.31: `You do not do so to Jehovah your God; for every abomination of Jehovah which He is hating they have done to their gods, for even their sons and their daughters they burn with fire to their gods.
12.32: The whole thing which I am commanding you--it you observe to do; you do not add to it, nor diminish from it.

13.1: `When there arises in your midst a prophet, or a dreamer of a dream, and he has given to you a sign or wonder,
13.2: and the sign and the wonder has come which he has spoken of to you, saying, Let us go after other gods (which you have not known), and serve them,
13.3: you do not hearken to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of the dream, for Jehovah your God is trying you, to know whether you are loving Jehovah your God with all your heart, and with all your soul;
13.4: after Jehovah your God you walk, and Him you fear, and His commands you keep, and to His voice you hearken, and Him you serve, and to Him you cleave.
13.5: `And that prophet, or that dreamer of the dream, is put to death, for he has spoken apostasy against Jehovah your God (who is bringing you out of the land of Egypt, and has ransomed you out of a house of servants), to drive you out of the way in which Jehovah your God has commanded you to walk, and you have put away the evil thing from your midst.
13.6: `When your brother--son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul--does move you, in secret, saying, Let us go and serve other gods--(which you have not known, you and your fathers,
13.7: of the gods of the peoples who are round about you, who are near to you, or who are far off from you, from the end of the earth even to the end of the earth) --
13.8: you do not consent to him, nor hearken to him, nor does your eye have pity on him, nor do you spare, nor do you cover him over.
13.9: `But you do surely kill him; your hand is on him, in the first place, to put him to death, and the hand of all the people last;
13.10: and you have stoned him with stones, and he has died, for he has sought to drive you away from Jehovah your God, who is bringing you out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
13.11: and all Israel do hear and fear, and add not to do like this evil thing in your midst.
13.12: `When you hear, in one of your cities which Jehovah your God is giving to you to dwell there, one saying,
13.13: Men, sons of worthlessness, have gone out of your midst, and they force away the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known--
13.14: and you have enquired, and searched, and asked diligently, and indeed, truth; the thing is established; this abomination has been done in your midst:
13.15: `You do surely smite the inhabitants of that city by the mouth of the sword; devoting it, and all that is in it, even its cattle, by the mouth of the sword;
13.16: and all its spoil you do gather to the midst of its broad place, and have burned with fire the city and all its spoil completely, before Jehovah your God, and it has been a heap age-during, it is not built any more;
13.17: and there does not cleave to your hand any of the devoted thing, so that Jehovah does turn back from the fierceness of His anger, and has given to you mercies, and loved you, and multiplied you, as He has sworn to your fathers,
13.18: when you do hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God, to keep all his commands which I am commanding you to-day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah your God.

14.1: `Sons you are to Jehovah your God; you do not cut yourselves, nor make baldness between your eyes for the dead;
14.2: for a holy people are you to Jehovah your God, and on you has Jehovah fixed to be to Him for a people, a peculiar treasure, out of all the peoples who are on the face of the ground.
14.3: `You do not eat any abominable thing;
14.4: `this is the beast which you do eat: ox, lamb of the sheep, or kid of the goats,
14.5: hart, and roe, and fallow deer, and wild goat, and pygarg, and wild ox, and chamois;
14.6: and every beast dividing the hoof, and cleaving the cleft into two hoofs, bringing up the cud, among the beasts--it you do eat.
14.7: `Only, this you do not eat, of those bringing up the cud, and of those dividing the cloven hoof: the camel, and the hare, and the rabbit, for they are bringing up the cud but the hoof have not divided; unclean they are to you;
14.8: and the sow, for it is dividing the hoof, and not bringing up the cud, unclean it is to you; of their flesh you do not eat, and against their carcase you do not come.
14.9: `This you do eat of all that are in the waters; all that has fins and scales you do eat;
14.10: and anything which has not fins and scales you do not eat; unclean it is to you.
14.12: and these are they of which you do not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
14.13: and the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after its kind,
14.14: and every raven after its kind;
14.15: and the owl, and the night-hawk, and the cuckoo, and the hawk after its kind;
14.16: the little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
14.17: and the pelican, and the gier-eagle, and the cormorant,
14.18: and the stork, and the heron after its kind, and the lapwing, and the bat;
14.19: and every teeming thing which is flying, unclean it is to you; they are not eaten;
14.20: any clean fowl you do eat.
14.21: `You do not eat of any carcase; to the sojourner who is within your gates you do give it, and he has eaten it; or sell it to a stranger; for a holy people you are to Jehovah your God; you do not boil a kid in its mother's milk.
14.22: `You do certainly tithe all the increase of your seed which the field is bringing forth year by year;
14.23: and you have eaten before Jehovah your God, in the place where He does choose to cause His name to tabernacle, the tithe of your corn, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstlings of your herd, and of your flock, so that you do learn to fear Jehovah your God all the days.
14.24: `And when the way is too much for you, that you are not able to carry it--when the place is too far off from you which Jehovah your God does choose to put His name there, when Jehovah your God does bless you; --
14.25: then you have given it in money, and have bound up the money in your hand, and gone to the place on which Jehovah your God does fix;
14.26: and you have given the money for any thing which your soul desires, for oxen, and for sheep, and for wine, and for strong drink, and for any thing which your soul asks, and you have eaten there before Jehovah your God, and you have rejoiced, you and your house.
14.27: As to the Levite who is within your gates, you do not forsake him, for he has no portion and inheritance with you.
14.28: `At the end of three years you do bring out all the tithe of your increase in that year, and have placed it within your gates;
14.29: and come in has the Levite (for he has no part and inheritance with you), and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, who are within your gates, and they have eaten, and been satisfied, so that Jehovah your God does bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

15.1: `At the end of seven years you do make a release,
15.2: and this is the matter of the release: Every owner of a loan is to release his hand which he does lift up against his neighbour, he does not exact of his neighbour and of his brother, but has proclaimed a release to Jehovah;
15.3: of the stranger you may exact, and that which is yours with your brother does your hand release;
15.4: only when there is no needy one with you, for Jehovah does greatly bless you in the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance to possess it.
15.5: `Only, if you do diligently hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God, to observe to do all this command which I am commanding you to-day,
15.6: for Jehovah your God has blessed you as He has spoken to you; and you have lent to many nations, and you have not borrowed; and you have ruled over many nations, and over you they do not rule.
15.7: `When there is with you any needy one of one of your brethren, in one of your cities, in your land which Jehovah your God is giving to you, you do not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your needy brother;
15.8: for you do certainly open your hand to him, and do certainly lend him sufficient for his lack which he lacks.
15.9: `Take heed to you lest there be a word in your heart--worthless, saying, Near is the seventh year, the year of release; and your eye is evil against your needy brother, and you do not give to him, and he has called concerning you to Jehovah, and it has been in you sin;
15.10: you do certainly give to him, and your heart is not sad in your giving to him, for because of this thing does Jehovah your God bless you in all your works, and in every putting forth of your hand;
15.11: because the needy one does not cease out of the land, therefore I am commanding you, saying, You do certainly open your hand to your brother, to your poor, and to your needy one, in your land.
15.12: `When your brother is sold to you, a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, and he has served you six years--then in the seventh year you do send him away free from you.
15.13: And when you do send him away free from you, you do not send him away empty;
15.14: you do certainly encircle him out of your flock, and out of your threshing-floor, and out of your wine-vat; of that which Jehovah your God has blessed you you do give to him,
15.15: and you have remembered that a servant you have been in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah your God does ransom you; therefore I am commanding you this thing to-day.
15.16: `And it has been, when he says to you, I go not out from you--because he has loved you, and your house, because it is good for him with you--
15.17: then you have taken the awl, and have put it through his ear, and through the door, and he has been to you a servant age-during; and also to your handmaid you do do so.
15.18: `It is not hard in your eyes, in your sending him away free from you; for the double of the hire of an hireling he has served you six years, and Jehovah your God has blessed you in all that you do.
15.19: `Every firstling that is born in your herd and in your flock--the male you do sanctify to Jehovah your God; you do not work with the firstling of your ox, nor shear the firstling of your flock;
15.20: before Jehovah your God you do eat it year by year, in the place which Jehovah does choose, you and your house.
15.21: `And when there is in it a blemish, lame, or blind, any evil blemish, you do not sacrifice it to Jehovah your God;
15.22: within your gates you do eat it, the unclean and the clean alike, as the roe, and as the hart.
15.23: Only, its blood you do not eat; on the earth you do pour it as water.

16.1: `Observe the month of Abib--and you have made a passover to Jehovah your God, for in the month of Abib has Jehovah your God brought you out of Egypt by night;
16.2: and you have sacrificed a passover to Jehovah your God, of the flock, and of the herd, in the place which Jehovah does choose to cause His name to tabernacle there.
16.3: `You do not eat with it any fermented thing, seven days you do eat with it unleavened things, bread of affliction; for in haste you have come out of the land of Egypt; so that you do remember the day of your coming out of the land of Egypt all days of your life;
16.4: and there is not seen with you leaven in all your border seven days, and there does not remain of the flesh which you do sacrifice at evening on the first day till morning.
16.5: `You are not able to sacrifice the passover within any of your gates which Jehovah your God is giving to you,
16.6: except at the place which Jehovah your God does choose to cause His name to tabernacle--there you do sacrifice the passover in the evening, at the going in of the sun, the season of your coming out of Egypt;
16.7: and you have cooked and eaten in the place on which Jehovah your God does fix, and have turned in the morning, and gone to your tents;
16.8: six days you do eat unleavened things, and on the seventh day is a restraint to Jehovah your God; you do do no work.
16.9: `Seven weeks you do number to you; from the beginning of the sickle among the standing corn you do begin to number seven weeks,
16.10: and you have made the feast of weeks to Jehovah your God, a tribute of a free-will offering of your hand, which you do give, as Jehovah your God does bless you.
16.11: And you have rejoiced before Jehovah your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your man-servant, and your handmaid, and the Levite who is within your gates, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, who are in your midst, in the place which Jehovah your God does choose to cause His name to tabernacle there,
16.12: and you have remembered that a servant you have been in Egypt, and have observed and done these statutes.
16.13: `The feast of booths you do make for you seven days, in your in-gathering of your threshing-floor, and of your wine-vat;
16.14: and you have rejoiced in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your man-servant, and your handmaid, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, who are within your gates.
16.15: Seven days you do feast before Jehovah your God, in the place which Jehovah does choose, for Jehovah your God does bless you in all your increase, and in every work of your hands, and you have been only rejoicing.
16.16: `Three times in a year does every one of your males appear before Jehovah your God in the place which He does choose--in the feast of unleavened things, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths; and they do not appear before Jehovah empty;
16.17: each according to the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of Jehovah your God, which He has given to you.
16.18: `Judges and authorities you do make to you within all your gates which Jehovah your God is giving to you, for your tribes; and they have judged the people--a righteous judgment.
16.19: You do not turn aside judgment; you do not discern faces, nor take a bribe, for the bribe blinds the eyes of the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.
16.20: Righteousness--righteousness you do pursue, so that you live, and have possessed the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you.
16.21: `You do not plant for you a shrine of any trees near the altar of Jehovah your God, which you make for yourself,
16.22: and you do not raise up to you any standing image which Jehovah your God is hating.

17.1: `You do not sacrifice to Jehovah your God ox or sheep in which there is a blemish--any evil thing; for it is the abomination of Jehovah your God.
17.2: `When there is found in your midst, in one of your cities which Jehovah your God is giving to you, a man or a woman who does the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah your God by transgressing His covenant,
17.3: and he does go and serve other gods, and does bow himself to them, and to the sun, or to the moon, or to any of the host of the heavens, which I have not commanded--
17.4: and it has been declared to you, and you have heard, and have searched diligently, and indeed, truth; the thing is established; this abomination has been done in Israel--
17.5: `Then you have brought out that man, or that woman, who has done this evil thing, to your gates--the man or the woman--and you have stoned them with stones, and they have died.
17.6: By the mouth of two witnesses or of three witnesses is he who is dead put to death; he is not put to death by the mouth of one witness;
17.7: the hand of the witnesses is on him, in the first place, to put him to death, and the hand of all the people last; and you have put away the evil thing out of your midst.
17.8: `When anything is too hard for you for judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke--matters of strife within your gates--then you have risen, and gone up to the place on which Jehovah your God does fix,
17.9: and have come in to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge who is in those days, and have inquired, and they have declared to you the word of judgment,
17.10: and you have done according to the tenor of the word which they declare to you (they of that place which Jehovah does choose; and you have observed to do according to all that they direct you.
17.11: `According to the tenor of the law which they direct you, and according to the judgment which they say to you you do do; you do not turn aside from the word which they declare to you, right or left.
17.12: And the man who acts with presumption, so as not to hearken to the priest (who is standing to serve there Jehovah your God), or to the judge, even that man has died, and you have put away the evil thing from Israel,
17.13: and all the people do hear and fear, and do not presume any more.
17.14: `When you come in to the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you, and have possessed it, and dwelt in it, and you have said, Let me set over me a king like all the nations which are round about me, --
17.15: you do certainly set over you a king on whom Jehovah does fix; from the midst of your brethren you do set over you a king; you are not able to set over you a stranger, who is not your brother.
17.16: `Only, he does not multiply to himself horses, nor cause the people to turn back to Egypt, so as to multiply horses, seeing Jehovah has said to you, You do not add to turn back in this way any more.
17.17: And he does not multiply to himself wives, and his heart does not turn aside, and silver and gold he does not multiply to himself--exceedingly.
17.18: `And it has been, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he has written for himself the copy of this law, on a book, from that before the priests the Levites,
17.19: and it has been with him, and he has read in it all days of his life, so that he does learn to fear Jehovah his God, to keep all the words of this law, and these statutes, to do them;
17.20: so that his heart is not high above his brethren, and so as not to turn aside from the command, right or left, so that he prolongs days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.

18.1: `There is not to the priests the Levites--all the tribe of Levi--a portion and inheritance with Israel; fire-offerings of Jehovah, even His inheritance, they eat,
18.2: and he has no inheritance in the midst of his brethren; Jehovah Himself is his inheritance, as He has spoken to him.
18.3: `And this is the priest's right from the people, from those sacrificing a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep, he has even given to the priest the leg, and the two cheeks, and the stomach;
18.4: the first of your corn, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your flock, you do give to him;
18.5: for on him has Jehovah your God fixed, out of all your tribes, to stand to serve in the name of Jehovah, He and his sons continually.
18.6: `And when the Levite comes from one of your cities out of all Israel, where he has sojourned, and has come with all the desire of his soul to the place which Jehovah does choose,
18.7: then he has ministered in the name of Jehovah his God, like all his brethren, the Levites, who are standing there before Jehovah,
18.8: portion as portion they do eat, apart from his sold things, with the fathers.
18.9: `When you are coming in to the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you, you do not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations:
18.10: there is not found in you one causing his son and his daughter to pass over into fire, a user of divinations, an observer of clouds, and an enchanter, and a sorcerer,
18.11: and a charmer, and one asking at a familiar spirit, and a wizard, and one seeking to the dead.
18.12: `For the abomination of Jehovah is every one doing these, and because of these abominations is Jehovah your God dispossessing them from your presence.
18.13: Perfect you are with Jehovah your God,
18.14: for these nations whom you are possessing, to observers of clouds, and to diviners, do hearken; and you--not so has Jehovah your God suffered you.
18.15: `A prophet out of your midst, out of your brethren, like to me, does Jehovah your God raise up to you--to him you hearken;
18.16: according to all that you did ask from Jehovah your God, in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not add to hear the voice of Jehovah my God, and this great fire let me not see any more, and I die not;
18.17: and Jehovah says to me, They have done well that they have spoken;
18.18: a prophet I raise up to them, out of the midst of their brethren, like to you; and I have given my words in his mouth, and he has spoken to them all that which I command him;
