18.19: and it has been--the man who does not hearken to My words which he does speak in My name, I require it of him.
18.20: `Only, the prophet who presumes to speak a word in My name--that which I have not commanded him to speak--and who speaks in the name of other gods--even that prophet has died.
18.21: `And when you say in your heart, How do we know the word which Jehovah has not spoken? --
18.22: that which the prophet speaks in the name of Jehovah, and the thing is not, and comes not--it is the word which Jehovah has not spoken; in presumption has the prophet spoken it; --you are not afraid of him.

19.1: `When Jehovah your God does cut off the nations, whose land Jehovah your God is giving to you, and you have succeeded them, and dwelt in their cities, and in their houses,
19.2: three cities you do separate for you in the midst of your land which Jehovah your God is giving to you to possess it.
19.3: You do prepare for you the way, and have divided into three parts the border of your land which Jehovah your God does cause you to inherit, and it has been for the fleeing there of every man-slayer.
19.4: `And this is the matter of the man-slayer who flees there, and has lived: He who smites his neighbour unknowingly, and is not hating him heretofore,
19.5: even he who comes in with his neighbour into a forest to hew wood, and his hand has driven with an axe to cut the tree, and the iron has slipped from the wood, and has met his neighbour, and he has died--he does flee to one of these cities, and has lived,
19.6: lest the redeemer of blood pursue after the man-slayer when his heart is hot, and has overtaken him (because the way is great), and has smitten him--the life, and he has no sentence of death, for he is not hating him heretofore;
19.7: therefore I am commanding you, saying, Three cities you do separate to you.
19.8: `And if Jehovah your God does enlarge your border, as He has sworn to your fathers, and has given to you all the land which He has spoken to give to your fathers--
19.9: when you keep all this command to do it, which I am commanding you to-day, to love Jehovah your God, and to walk in His ways all the days--then you have added to you yet three cities to these three;
19.10: and innocent blood is not shed in the midst of your land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance, and there has been upon you blood.
19.11: `And when a man is hating his neighbour, and has lain in wait for him, and risen against him, and smitten him--the life, and he has died, and he has fled to one of these cities,
19.12: then the elders of his city have sent and taken him from from there, and given him into the hand of the redeemer of blood, and he has died;
19.13: your eye has no pity on him, and you have put away the innocent blood from Israel, and it is well with you.
19.14: `You do not remove a border of your neighbour, which they of former times have made, in your inheritance, which you do inherit in the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you to possess it.
19.15: `One witness does not rise against a man for any iniquity, and for any sin, in any sin which he sins; by the mouth of two witnesses, or by the mouth of three witnesses, is a thing established.
19.16: `When a violent witness does rise against a man, to testify against him apostasy,
19.17: then have both the men who have the strife stood before Jehovah, before the priests and the judges who are in those days,
19.18: and the judges have searched diligently, and indeed, the witness is a false witness, a falsehood he has testified against his brother:
19.19: `Then you have done to him as he devised to do to his brother, and you have put away the evil thing out of your midst,
19.20: and those who are left do hear and fear, and add not to do any more according to this evil thing in your midst;
19.21: and your eye does not pity--life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

20.1: `When you go out to battle against your enemy, and have seen horse and chariot--a people more numerous than you--you are not afraid of them, for Jehovah your God is with you, who is bringing you up out of the land of Egypt;
20.2: and it has been, in your drawing near to the battle, that the priest has come nigh, and spoken to the people,
20.3: and said to them, Hear, Israel, you are drawing near to-day to battle against your enemies, let not your hearts be tender, fear not, nor make haste, nor be terrified at their presence,
20.4: for Jehovah your God is He who is going with you, to fight for you with your enemies--to save you.
20.5: `And the authorities have spoken to the people, saying, Who is the man that has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? --let him go and turn back to his house, lest he die in battle, and another man dedicate it.
20.6: `And who is the man that has planted a vineyard, and has not made it common? --let him go and turn back to his house, lest he die in battle, and another man make it common.
20.7: `And who is the man that has betrothed a woman, and has not taken her? --let him go and turn back to his house, lest he die in battle, and another man take her.
20.8: `And the authorities have added to speak to the people, and said, Who is the man that is afraid and tender of heart? --let him go and turn back to his house, and the heart of his brethren does not melt like his heart;
20.9: and it has come to pass as the authorities finish to speak to the people, that they have appointed princes of the hosts at the head of the people.
20.10: `When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then you have called to it for Peace,
20.11: and it has been, if Peace it answer you, and has opened to you, then it has come to pass--all the people who are found in it are to you for tributaries, and have served you.
20.12: `And if it does not make peace with you, and has made with you war, then you have laid siege against it,
20.13: and Jehovah your God has given it into your hand, and you have smitten every male of it by the mouth of the sword.
20.14: Only, the women, and the infants, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, all its spoil, you do seize for yourself, and you have eaten the spoil of your enemies which Jehovah your God has given to you.
20.15: So you do do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.
20.16: `Only, of the cities of these peoples which Jehovah your God is giving to you for an inheritance, you do not keep alive any breathing;
20.17: for you do certainly devote the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Jehovah your God has commanded you,
20.18: so that they teach you not to do according to all their abominations which they have done to their gods, and you have sinned against Jehovah your God.
20.19: `When you lay siege to a city many days, to fight against it, to capture it, you do not destroy its trees to force an axe against them, for of them you do eat, and them you do not cut down--for man's is the tree of the field--to go in at your presence in the siege.
20.20: Only, the tree, which you know that it is not a fruit-tree, it you do destroy, and have cut down, and have built a bulwark against the city which is making with you war till you have subdued it.

21.1: `When one is found slain on the ground which Jehovah your God is giving to you to possess it--fallen in a field--it is not known who has smitten him,
21.2: then have your elders and your judges gone out and measured to the cities which are round about the slain one,
21.3: and it has been, the city which is near to the slain one, even the elders of that city have taken a heifer of the herd, which has not been worked with, which has not drawn in the yoke,
21.4: and the elders of that city have brought down the heifer to a hard valley, which is not tilled nor sown, and have beheaded there the heifer in the valley.
21.5: `And the priests, sons of Levi, have come nigh--for on them has Jehovah your God fixed to serve Him, and to bless in the name of Jehovah, and by their mouth is every strife, and every stroke--
21.6: and all the elders of that city, who are near to the slain one, do wash their hands over the heifer which is beheaded in the valley,
21.7: and they have answered and said, Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen--
21.8: receive atonement for Your people Israel, whom You have ransomed, O Jehovah, and suffer not innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel; and the blood has been pardoned to them,
21.9: and you do put away the innocent blood out of your midst, for you do that which is right in the eyes of Jehovah.
21.10: `When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Jehovah your God has given them into your hand, and you have taken captive its captivity,
21.11: and have seen in the captivity a woman of fair form, and have delighted in her, and have taken to you for a wife,
21.12: then you have brought her in to the midst of your household, and she has shaved her head, and prepared her nails,
21.13: and turned aside the raiment of her captivity from off her, and has dwelt in your house, and bewailed her father and her mother a month of days, and afterwards you do go in to her and have married her, and she has been to you for a wife:
21.14: `And it has been--if you have not delighted in her, that you have sent her away at her desire, and you do not at all sell her for money; you do not tyrannize over her, because that you have humbled her.
21.15: `When a man has two wives, the one loved and the other hated, and they have borne to him sons (the loved one and the hated one), and the first-born son has been to the hated one;
21.16: then it has been, in the day of his causing his sons to inherit that which he has, he is not able to declare first-born the son of the loved one, in the face of the son of the hated one--the first-born.
21.17: But the first-born, son of the hated one, he does acknowledge, to give to him a double portion of all that is found with him, for he is the beginning of his strength; to him is the right of the first-born.
21.18: `When a man has a son apostatizing and rebellious--he is not hearkening to the voice of his father, and to the voice of his mother, and they have chastised him, and he does not hearken to them--
21.19: then laid hold on him have his father and his mother, and they have brought him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place,
21.20: and have said to the elders of his city, Our son--this one--is apostatizing and rebellious; he is not hearkening to our voice--a glutton and drunkard;
21.21: and all the men of his city have stoned him with stones, and he has died, and you have put away the evil out of your midst, and all Israel do hear and fear.
21.22: `And when there is in a man a sin--a cause of death, and he has been put to death, and you have hanged him on a tree,
21.23: his corpse does not remain on the tree, for you do certainly bury him in that day--for a thing lightly esteemed of God is the hanged one--and you do not defile your ground which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance.

22.1: `You do not see the ox of your brother or his sheep driven away, and have hidden yourself from them, you do certainly turn them back to your brother;
22.2: and if your brother is not near to you, and you have not known him, then you have removed it to the midst of your house, and it has been with you till your brother seek it, and you have given it back to him;
22.3: and so you do to his ass, and so you do to his garment, and so you do to any lost thing of your brother's, which is lost by him, and you have found it; you are not able to hide yourself.
22.4: `You do not see the ass of your brother, or his ox, falling in the way, and have hid yourself from them; you do certainly raise them up with him.
22.5: `The habiliments of a man are not on a woman, nor does a man put on the garment of a woman, for the abomination of Jehovah your God is any one doing these.
22.6: `When a bird's nest comes before you in the way, in any tree, or on the earth, brood or eggs, and the mother sitting on the brood or on the eggs, you do not take the mother with the young ones;
22.7: you do certainly send away the mother, and the young ones do take to yourself, so that it is well with you, and you have prolonged days.
22.8: `When you build a new house, then you have made a parapet to your roof, and you do not put blood on your house when one falls from it.
22.9: `You do not sow your vineyard with divers things, lest the fulness of the seed which you do sow, and the increase of the vineyard, be separated.
22.10: `You do not plow with an ox and with an ass together.
22.11: `You do not put on a mixed cloth, wool and linen together.
22.12: `Fringes you do make to you on the four skirts of your covering with which you do cover yourself.
22.13: `When a man takes a wife, and has gone in to her, and hated her,
22.14: and laid against her actions of words, and brought out against her an evil name, and said, This woman I have taken, and I draw near to her, and I have not found in her tokens of virginity:
22.15: `Then has the father of the damsel--and her mother--taken and brought out the tokens of virginity of the damsel to the elders of the city in the gate,
22.16: and the father of the damsel has said to the elders, My daughter I have given to this man for a wife, and he does hate her;
22.17: and indeed, he has laid actions of words, saying, I have not found to your daughter tokens of virginity--and these are the tokens of the virginity of my daughter! and they have spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
22.18: `And the elders of that city have taken the man, and chastise him,
22.19: and fined him a hundred silverlings, and given to the father of the damsel, because he has brought out an evil name on a virgin of Israel, and she is to him for a wife, he is not able to send her away all his days.
22.20: `And if this thing has been truth--tokens of virginity have not been found for the damsel--
22.21: then they have brought out the damsel to the opening of her father's house, and stoned her have the men of her city with stones, and she has died, for she has done folly in Israel, to go a-whoring in her father's house; and you have put away the evil thing out of your midst.
22.22: `When a man is found lying with a woman, married to a husband, then they have died even both of them, the man who is lying with the woman, also the woman; and you have put away the evil thing out of Israel.
22.23: `When there is a damsel, a virgin, betrothed to a man, and a man has found her in a city, and lain with her;
22.24: then you have brought them both out to the gate of that city, and stoned them with stones, and they have died: --the damsel, because that she has not cried, being in a city; and the man, because that he has humbled his neighbour's wife; and you have put away the evil thing out of your midst.
22.25: `And if in a field the man find the damsel who is betrothed, and the man has laid hold on her, and lain with her, then has the man who has lain with her died alone;
22.26: and to the damsel you do not do anything, the damsel has no deadly sin; for as a man rises against his neighbour and has murdered him--the life, so is this thing;
22.27: for in a field he found her, she has cried--the damsel who is betrothed--and she has no saviour.
22.28: `When a man finds a damsel, a virgin who is not betrothed, and has caught her, and lain with her, and they have been found,
22.29: then has the man who is lying with her given to the father of the damsel fifty silverlings, and to him she is for a wife; because that he has humbled her, he is not able to send her away all his days.
22.30: `A man does not take his father's wife, nor uncover his father's skirt.

23.1: `One wounded, bruised, or cut in the member does not enter into the assembly of Jehovah;
23.2: a bastard does not enter into the assembly of Jehovah; even a tenth generation of him does not enter into the assembly of Jehovah.
23.3: `An Ammonite and a Moabite does not enter into the assembly of Jehovah; even a tenth generation of them does not enter into the assembly of Jehovah--to the age;
23.4: because that they have not come before you with bread and with water in the way, in your coming out from Egypt, and because he has hired against you Balaam son of Beor, of Pethor of Aram-Naharaim, to revile you;
23.5: and Jehovah your God has not been willing to hearken to Balaam, and Jehovah your God does turn for you the reviling to a blessing, because Jehovah your God has loved you;
23.6: you do not seek their peace and their good all your days--to the age.
23.7: `You do not abominate an Edomite, for your brother he is; you do not abominate an Egyptian, for a sojourner you have been in his land;
23.8: sons who are begotten of them, a third generation of them, does enter into the assembly of Jehovah.
23.9: `When a camp goes out against your enemies, then you have kept from every evil thing.
23.10: `When there is in you a man who is not clean, from an accident at night--then he has gone out to the outside of the camp--he does not come in to the midst of the camp--
23.11: and it has been, at the turning of the evening, he does bathe with water, and at the going in of the sun he does come in to the midst of the camp.
23.12: `And a station you have at the outside of the camp, and you have gone out there without,
23.13: and a nail you have on your staff, and it has been, in your sitting without, that you have digged with it, and turned back, and covered your filth;
23.14: for Jehovah your God is walking up and down in the midst of your camp, to deliver you, and to give your enemies before you, and your camp has been holy, and He does not see in you the nakedness of anything, and has turned back from after you.
23.15: `You do not shut up a servant to his lord, who is delivered to you from his lord;
23.16: with you he does dwell, in your midst, in the place which he chooses within one of your gates, where it is pleasing to him; you do not oppress him.
23.17: `There is not a whore among the daughters of Israel, nor is there a whoremonger among the sons of Israel;
23.18: you do not bring a gift of a whore, or a price of a dog, into the house of Jehovah your God, for any vow; for the abomination of Jehovah your God are even both of them.
23.19: `You do not lend in usury to your brother; usury of money, usury of food, usury of anything which is lent on usury.
23.20: To a stranger you may lend in usury, and to your brother you do not lend in usury, so that Jehovah your God does bless you in every putting forth of your hand on the land where you go in to possess it.
23.21: `When you vow a vow to Jehovah your God, you do not delay to complete it; for Jehovah your God does certainly require it from you, and it has been in you--sin.
23.22: `And when you forbear to vow, it is not in you a sin.
23.23: The produce of your lips you do keep, and have done it, as you have vowed to Jehovah your God; a free-will-offering, which you have spoken with your mouth.
23.24: `When you come in to the vineyard of your neighbour, then you have eaten grapes, according to your desire, your sufficiency; but into your vessel you do not put any.
23.25: When you come in among the standing-corn of your neighbour, then you have plucked the ears with your hand, but a sickle you do not wave over the standing-corn of your neighbour.

24.1: `When a man does take a wife, and has married her, and it has been, if she does not find grace in his eyes (for he has found in her nakedness of anything), and he has written for her a writing of divorce, and given it into her hand, and sent her out of his house,
24.2: and she has gone out of his house, and has gone and been another man's,
24.3: and the latter man has hated her, and written for her a writing of divorce, and given it into her hand, and sent her out of his house, or when the latter man dies, who has taken her to himself for a wife:
24.4: `Her former husband who sent her away is not able to turn back to take her to be to him for a wife, after that she has become defiled; for an abomination it is before Jehovah, and you do not cause the land to sin which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance.
24.5: `When a man takes a new wife, he does not go out into the host, and one does not pass over to him for anything; free he is at his own house one year, and has rejoiced his wife whom he has taken.
24.6: `None does take in pledge millstones, and rider, for life it is he is taking in pledge.
24.7: `When a man is found stealing a person, of his brethren, of the sons of Israel, and has tyrannized over him, and sold him, then has that thief died, and you have put away the evil thing out of your midst.
24.8: `Take heed, in the plague of leprosy, to watch greatly, and to do according to all that the priests, the Levites, teach you; as I have commanded them you observe to do;
24.9: remember that which Jehovah your God has done to Miriam in the way, in your coming out of Egypt.
24.10: `When you lift up on your brother a debt of anything, you do not go in to his house to obtain his pledge;
24.11: at the outside you do stand, and the man on whom you are lifting it up is bringing out to you the pledge at the outside.
24.12: `And if he is a poor man, you do not lie down with his pledge;
24.13: you do certainly give back to him the pledge at the going in of the sun, and he has lain down in his own raiment, and has blessed you; and to you it is righteousness before Jehovah your God.
24.14: `You do not oppress a hireling, poor and needy, of your brethren or of your sojourner who is in your land within your gates;
24.15: in his day you do give his hire, and the sun does not go in upon it, for he is poor, and to it he is lifting up his soul, and he does not cry against you to Jehovah, and it has been in you--sin.
24.16: `Fathers are not put to death for sons, and sons are not put to death for fathers--each for his own sin, they are put to death.
24.17: `You do not turn aside the judgment of a fatherless sojourner, nor take in pledge the garment of a widow;
24.18: and you have remembered that a servant you have been in Egypt, and Jehovah your God does ransom you from from there; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.
24.19: `When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in a field, you do not turn back to take it; to the sojourner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, it is; so that Jehovah your God does bless you in all the work of your hands.
24.20: `When you beat your olive, you do not examine the branch behind you; to the sojourner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, it is.
24.21: `When you cut your vineyard, you do not glean behind you; to the sojourner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, it is;
24.22: and you have remembered that a servant you have been in the land of Egypt; therefore I am commanding you to do this thing.

25.1: `When there is a strife between men, and they have come nigh to the judgment, and they have judged, and declared righteous the righteous, and declared wrong the wrong-doer,
25.2: then it has come to pass, if the wrong-doer is to be smitten, that the judge has caused him to fall down, and one has smitten him in his presence, according to the sufficiency of his wrong-doing, by number;
25.3: forty times he does smite him--he is not adding, lest, he is adding to smite him above these--many stripes, and your brother is lightly esteemed in your eyes.
25.4: `You do not muzzle an ox in its threshing.
25.5: `When brethren dwell together, and one of them has died, and has no son, the wife of the dead is not without to a strange man; her husband's brother does go in to her, and has taken her to him for a wife, and does perform the duty of her husband's brother;
25.6: and it has been, the first-born which she bears does rise for the name of his dead brother, and his name is not wiped away out of Israel.
25.7: `And if the man does not delight to take his brother's wife, then has his brother's wife gone up to the gate, to the elders, and said, My husband's brother is refusing to raise up to his brother a name in Israel; he has not been willing to perform the duty of my husband's brother;
25.8: and the elders of his city have called for him, and spoken to him, and he has stood and said, I have no desire to take her;
25.9: `Then has his brother's wife drawn nigh to him, before the eyes of the elders, and drawn his shoe from off his foot, and spat in his face, and answered and said, Thus it is done to the man who does not build up the house of his brother;
25.10: and his name has been called in Israel--The house of him whose shoe is drawn off.
25.11: `When men strive together, one with another, and the wife of the one has drawn near to deliver her husband out of the hand of his smiter, and has put forth her hand, and laid hold on his secrets,
25.12: then you have cut off her hand, your eye does not spare.
25.13: `You have not in your bag a stone and a stone, a great and a small.
25.14: You have not in your house an ephah and an ephah, a great and a small.
25.15: You have a stone complete and just, you have an ephah complete and just, so that they prolong your days on the ground which Jehovah your God is giving to you;
25.16: for the abomination of Jehovah your God is any one doing these things, any one doing iniquity.
25.17: `Remember that which Amalek has done to you in the way, in your going out from Egypt,
25.18: that he has met you in the way, and smites in all those feeble behind you (and you wearied and fatigued), and is not fearing God.
25.19: And it has been, in Jehovah your God's giving rest to you, from all your enemies round about, in the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance to possess it--you do blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under the heavens--you do not forget.

26.1: `And it has been, when you come in to the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--an inheritance, and you have possessed it, and dwelt in it,
26.2: that you have taken of the first of all the fruits of the ground which you do bring in out of your land which Jehovah your God is giving to you, and have put it in a basket, and gone to the place which Jehovah your God does choose to cause His name to tabernacle there.
26.3: `And you have come in to the priest who is in those days, and have said to him, I have declared to-day to Jehovah your God, that I have come in to the land which Jehovah has sworn to our fathers to give to us;
26.4: and the priest has taken the basket out of your hand, and placed it before the altar of Jehovah your God.
26.5: `And you have answered and said before Jehovah your God, A perishing Aramaean is my father! and he goes down to Egypt, and sojourns there with few men, and becomes there a nation, great, mighty, and numerous;
26.6: and the Egyptians do us evil, and afflict us, and put on us hard service;
26.7: and we cry to Jehovah, God of our fathers, and Jehovah hears our voice, and sees our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression;
26.8: and Jehovah brings us out from Egypt, by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great fear, and by signs, and by wonders,
26.9: and he brings us in to this place, and gives to us this land--a land flowing with milk and honey.
26.10: `And now, indeed, I have brought in the first of the fruits of the ground which you have given to me, O Jehovah; --and you have placed it before Jehovah your God, and bowed yourself before Jehovah your God,
26.11: and rejoiced in all the good which Jehovah your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the sojourner who is in your midst.
26.12: `When you do complete to tithe all the tithe of your increase in the third year, the year of the tithe, then you have given to the Levite, to the sojourner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, and they have eaten within your gates, and been satisfied,
26.13: and you have said before Jehovah your God, I have put away the separated thing out of the house, and also have given it to the Levite, and to the sojourner, and to the orphan, and to the widow, according to all Your command which You have commanded me; I have not passed over from Your commands, nor have I forgotten.
26.14: I have not eaten in my affliction of it, nor have I put away of it for uncleanness, nor have I given of it for the dead; I have hearkened to the voice of Jehovah my God; I have done according to all that You have commanded me;
26.15: look from Your holy habitation, from the heavens, and bless Your people Israel, and the ground which You have given to us, as You have sworn to our fathers--a land flowing with milk and honey.
26.16: `This day Jehovah your God is commanding you to do these statutes and judgments; and you have hearkened and done them with all your heart, and with all your soul,
26.17: Jehovah you have caused to promise to-day to become your God, and to walk in His ways, and to keep His statutes, and His commands, and His judgments, and to hearken to His voice.
26.18: `And Jehovah has caused you to promise to-day to become His people, a peculiar treasure, as He has spoken to you, and to keep all His commands;
26.19: so as to make you uppermost above all the nations whom He has made for a praise, and for a name, and for beauty, and for your being a holy people to Jehovah your God, as He has spoken.

27.1: `And Moses--the elders of Israel also--commands the people, saying, Keep all the command which I am commanding you to-day;
27.2: and it has been, in the day that you pass over the Jordan to the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you, that you have raised up for you great stones, and plaistered them with plaister,
27.3: and written on them all the words of this law in your passing over, so that you go in to the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you--a land flowing with milk and honey, as Jehovah, God of your fathers, has spoken to you.
27.4: `And it has been, in your passing over the Jordan, you raise up these stones which I am commanding you to-day, in mount Ebal, and you have plaistered them with plaister,
27.5: and built there an altar to Jehovah your God, an altar of stones, you do not wave over them iron.
27.6: Of complete stones you build the altar of Jehovah your God, and have caused to ascend on it burnt-offerings to Jehovah your God,
27.7: and sacrificed peace-offerings, and eaten there, and rejoiced before Jehovah your God,
27.8: and written on the stones all the words of this law, well engraved.'
27.9: And Moses speaks--the priests, the Levites, also--to all Israel, saying, `Keep silent, and hear, O Israel, this day you have become a people to Jehovah your God;
27.10: and you have hearkened to the voice of Jehovah your God, and done His commands, and His statutes, which I am commanding you to-day.'
27.11: And Moses commands the people on that day, saying,
27.12: `These do stand, to bless the people, on mount Gerizzim, in your passing over the Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.
27.13: And these do stand, for the reviling, on mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
27.14: `And the Levites have answered and said to every man of Israel--a loud voice:
27.15: `Cursed is the man who makes a graven and molten image, the abomination of Jehovah, work of the hands of an artificer, and has put it in a secret place, --and all the people have answered and said, Amen.
27.16: `Cursed is He who is making light of his father and his mother, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.17: `Cursed is he who is removing his neighbour's border, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.18: `Cursed is he who is causing the blind to err in the way, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.19: `Cursed is he who is turning aside the judgment of fatherless, sojourner, and widow, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.20: `Cursed is he who is lying with his father's wife, for he has uncovered his father's skirt, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.21: `Cursed is he who is lying with any beast, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.22: `Cursed is he who is lying with his sister, daughter of his father, or daughter of his mother, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.23: `Cursed is he who is lying with his mother-in-law, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.24: `Cursed is he who is smiting his neighbour in secret, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.25: `Cursed is he who is taking a bribe to smite a person, innocent blood, --and all the people have said, Amen.
27.26: `Cursed is he who does not establish the words of this law, to do them, --and all the people have said, Amen.

28.1: `And it has been, if you do hearken diligently to the voice of Jehovah your God, to observe to do all His commands which I am commanding you to-day, that Jehovah your God has made you uppermost above all the nations of the earth,
28.2: and all these blessings have come upon you, and overtaken you, because you do hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God:
28.3: `Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
28.4: `Blessed is the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, increase of your oxen, and wealth of your flock.
28.5: `Blessed is your basket and your kneading-trough.
28.6: `Blessed are you in your coming in, and blessed are you in your going out.
28.7: `Jehovah gives your enemies, who are rising up against you--smitten before your face; in one way they come out to you, and in seven ways they flee before you.
28.8: `Jehovah commands with you the blessing in your storehouses, and in every putting forth of your hand, and has blessed you in the land which Jehovah your God is giving to you.
28.9: `Jehovah does establish you to Himself for a holy people, as He has sworn to you, when you keep the commands of Jehovah your God, and have walked in His ways;
28.10: and all the peoples of the land have seen that the name of Jehovah is called upon you, and they have been afraid of you.
28.11: `And Jehovah has made you abundant in good, in the fruit of the womb, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, on the ground which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers to give to you.
28.12: `Jehovah does open to you his good treasure--the heavens--to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand, and you have lent to many nations, and you--you do not borrow.
28.13: `And Jehovah has given you for head, and not for tail; and you have been only above, and are not beneath, for you do hearken to the commands of Jehovah your God, which I am commanding you to-day, to keep and to do,
28.14: and you do not turn aside from all the words which I am commanding you to-day--right or left--to go after other gods, to serve them.
28.15: `And it has been, if you do not hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God to observe to do all His commands, and His statutes, which I am commanding you to-day, that all these revilings have come upon you, and overtaken you:
28.16: `Cursed are you in the city, and cursed are you in the field.
28.17: `Cursed is your basket and your kneading-trough.
28.18: `Cursed is the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your land, increase of your oxen, and wealth of your flock.
28.19: `Cursed are you in your coming in, and cursed are you in your going out.
28.20: `Jehovah does send on you the curse, the trouble, and the rebuke, in every putting forth of your hand which you do, till you are destroyed, and till you perish hastily, because of the evil of your doings by which you have forsaken Me.
28.21: `Jehovah does cause to cleave to you the pestilence, till He consume you from off the ground where you are going in to possess it.
28.22: `Jehovah does smite you with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with extreme burning, and with sword, and with blasting, and with mildew, and they have pursued you till you perish
28.23: `And your heavens which are over your head have been brass, and the earth which is under you iron;
28.24: Jehovah gives the rain of your land--dust and ashes; from the heavens it comes down on you till you are destroyed.
28.25: `Jehovah gives you smitten before your enemies; in one way you go out to them, and in seven ways do flee before them, and you have been for a trembling to all kingdoms of the earth;
28.26: and your carcase has been for food to every fowl of the heavens, and to the beast of the earth, and there is none causing trembling.
28.27: `Jehovah does smite you with the ulcer of Egypt, and with emerods, and with scurvy, and with itch, of which you are not able to be healed.
28.28: `Jehovah does smite you with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart;
28.29: and you have been gropling at noon, as the blind gropes in darkness; and you do not cause your ways to prosper; and you have been only oppressed and plundered all the days, and there is no saviour.
28.30: `A woman you do betroth, and another man does lie with her; a house you do build, and do not dwell in it; a vineyard you do plant, and do not make it common;
28.31: your ox is slaughtered before your eyes, and you do not eat of it; your ass is taken violently away from before you, and it is not given back to you; your sheep are given to your enemies, and there is no saviour for you.
28.32: `Your sons and your daughters are given to another people, and your eyes are looking and consuming for them all the day, and your hand is not to God!
28.33: The fruit of your ground, and all your labour, eat up does a people whom you have not known; and you have been only oppressed and bruised all the days;
28.34: and you have been mad, because of the sight of your eyes which you do see.
28.35: `Jehovah does smite you with an evil ulcer, on the knees, and on the legs (of which you are not able to be healed), from the sole of your foot even to your crown.
28.36: `Jehovah does cause you to go, and your king whom you raise up over you, to a nation which you have not known, you and your fathers, and you have served there other gods, wood and stone;
28.37: and you have been for an astonishment, for a simile, and for a byword among all the peoples where Jehovah does lead you.
28.38: `Much seed you do take out into the field, and little you do gather in, for the locust does consume it;
28.39: vineyards you do plant, and have laboured, and wine you do not drink nor gather, for the worm does consume it;
28.40: olives are to you in all your border, and oil you do not pour out, for your olive does fall off.
28.41: `Sons and daughters you do beget, and they are not with you, for they go into captivity;
28.42: all your trees and the fruit of your ground does the locust possess;
28.43: the sojourner who is in your midst goes up above you very high, and you go down very low;
28.44: he does lend to you, and you do not lend to him; he is for head, and you are for tail.
28.45: `And come upon you have all these curses, and they have pursued you, and overtaken you, till you are destroyed, because you have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah your God, to keep His commands, and His statutes, which he has commanded you;
28.46: and they have been on you for a sign and for a wonder, also on your seed--to the age.
28.47: `Because that you have not served Jehovah your God with joy, and with gladness of heart, because of the abundance of all things--
28.48: you have served your enemies, whom Jehovah sends against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in lack of all things; and he has put a yoke of iron on your neck, till He has destroyed you.
28.49: `Jehovah does lift up against you a nation, from afar, from the end of the earth, as the eagle it flies; a nation whose tongue you have not heard,
28.50: a nation--fierce of countenance--which accepts not the face of the aged, and the young does not favour;
28.51: and it has eaten the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your ground, till you are destroyed; which leaves not to you corn, new wine, and oil, increase of your oxen, and wealth of your flock, till it has destroyed you.
28.52: `And it has laid siege to you in all your gates, till your walls come down, the high and the fenced ones in which you are trusting, in all your land; yes, it has laid siege to you in all your gates, in all your land, which Jehovah your God has given to you;
28.53: and you have eaten the fruit of your body, flesh of your sons and your daughters (whom Jehovah your God has given to you), in the siege, and in the straitness with which your enemies do straiten you.
28.54: `The man who is tender in you, and who is very delicate--his eye is evil against his brother, and against the wife of his bosom, and against the remnant of his sons whom he leaves,
28.55: against giving to one of them of the flesh of his sons whom he eats, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege, and in the straitness with which your enemy does straiten you in all your gates.
28.56: `The tender woman in you, and the delicate, who has not tried the sole of her foot to place on the ground because of delicateness and because of tenderness--her eye is evil against the husband of her bosom, and against her son, and against her daughter,
28.57: and against her seed which comes out from between her feet, even against her sons whom she does bear, for she does eat them for the lacking of all things in secret, in the siege and in the straitness with which your enemy does straiten you within your gates.
28.58: `If you do not observe to do all the words of this law which are written in this book, to fear this honoured and fearful name--Jehovah your God--
28.59: then has Jehovah made wonderful your strokes, and the strokes of your seed--great strokes, and stedfast, and evil sicknesses, and stedfast.
28.60: `And He has brought back on you all the diseases of Egypt, of the presence of which you have been afraid, and they have cleaved to you;
28.61: also every sickness and every stroke which is not written in the book of this law; Jehovah does cause them to go up upon you till you are destroyed,
28.62: and you have been left with few men, instead of which you have been as stars of the heavens for multitude, because you have not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah your God.
28.63: `And it has been, as Jehovah has rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so does Jehovah rejoice over you to destroy you, and to lay you waste; and you have been pulled away from off the ground where you are going in to possess it;
28.64: and Jehovah has scattered you among all the peoples, from the end of the earth even to the end of the earth; and you have served there other gods which you have not known, you and your fathers--wood and stone.
28.65: `And among those nations you do not rest, yes, there is no resting-place for the sole of your foot, and Jehovah has given to you there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and grief of soul;
28.66: and your life has been hanging in suspense before you, and you have been afraid by night and by day, and do not believe in your life;
28.67: in the morning you say, O that it were evening! and in the evening you say, O that it were morning! from the fear of your heart, with which you are afraid, and from the sight of your eyes which you see.
28.68: `And Jehovah has brought you back to Egypt with ships, by a way of which I said to you, You do not add any more to see it, and you have sold yourselves there to your enemies, for men-servants and for maid-servants, and there is no buyer.'

29.1: These are the words of the covenant which Jehovah has commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, apart from the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.
29.2: And Moses calls to all Israel, and says to them, `You--you have seen all that which Jehovah has done before your eyes in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
29.3: the great trials which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great wonders;
29.4: and Jehovah has not given to you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, till this day,
29.5: and I cause you to go forty years in a wilderness; your garments have not been consumed from off you, and your shoe has not worn away from off your foot;
29.6: bread you have not eaten, and wine and strong drink you have not drunk, so that you know that I am Jehovah your God.
29.7: `And you come in to this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon--also Og king of Bashan--does come out to meet us, to battle, and we smite them,
29.8: and take their land, and give it for an inheritance to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite, and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh;
29.9: and you have kept the words of this covenant, and done them, so that you cause all that you do to prosper.
29.10: `You are standing to-day, all of you, before Jehovah your God--your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your authorities--every man of Israel;
29.11: your infants, your wives, and your sojourner who is in the midst of your camps, from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water--
29.12: for your passing over into the covenant of Jehovah your God, and into His oath which Jehovah your God is making with you to-day;
29.13: in order to establish you to-day to Him for a people, and He Himself is your God, as He has spoken to you, and as He has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
29.14: `And not with you alone am I making this covenant and this oath;
29.15: but with him who is here with us, standing to-day before Jehovah our God, and with him who is not here with us to-day,
29.16: for you have known how you dwelt in the land of Egypt, and how we passed by through the midst of the nations which you have passed by;
29.17: and you see their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which are with them,
29.18: lest there be among you a man or woman, or family or tribe, whose heart is turning to-day from Jehovah our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations, lest there be in you a root fruitful of gall and wormwood:
29.19: `And it has been, in his hearing the words of this oath, and he has blessed himself in his heart, saying, I have peace, though in the stubbornness of my heart I go on, in order to end the fulness with the thirst.
29.20: Jehovah is not willing to be propitious to him, for then does the anger of Jehovah smoke, also His zeal, against that man, and lain down on him has all the oath which is written in this book, and Jehovah has blotted out his name from under the heavens,
29.21: and Jehovah has separated him for evil, out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the oaths of the covenant which is written in this book of the law.
29.22: `And the latter generation of your sons who rise after you, and the stranger who comes in from a land afar off, have said when they have seen the strokes of that land, and its sicknesses which Jehovah has sent into it, --
29.23: (with brimstone and salt is the whole land burnt, it is not sown, nor does it shoot up, nor does there go up on it any herb, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboim, which Jehovah overturned in His anger, and in His fury,) --
29.24: yes, all the nations have said, Wherefore has Jehovah done thus to this land? what the heat of this great anger?
29.25: `And they have said, Because that they have forsaken the covenant of Jehovah, God of their fathers, which He made with them in His bringing them out of the land of Egypt,
29.26: and they go and serve other gods, and bow themselves to them--gods which they have not known, and which He has not apportioned to them;
29.27: and the anger of Jehovah burns against that land, to bring in on it all the reviling that is written in this book,
29.28: and Jehovah does pluck them from off their ground in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath, and does cast them to another land, as at this day.
29.29: `The things hidden are to Jehovah our God, and the things revealed are to us and to our sons--to the age, to do all the words of this law.

30.1: `And it has been, when all these things come upon you, the blessing and the reviling, which I have set before you, and you have brought them back to your heart, among all the nations where Jehovah your God has driven you away,
30.2: and have turned back to Jehovah your God, and hearkened to His voice, according to all that I am commanding you to-day, you and your sons, with all your heart, and with all your soul--
30.3: then has Jehovah your God turned back to your captivity, and pitied you, yes, He has turned back and gathered you out of all the peoples where Jehovah your God has scattered you.
30.4: `If your outcast is in the extremity of the heavens, from there does Jehovah your God gather you, and from there He does take you;
30.5: and Jehovah your God has brought you in to the land which your fathers have possessed, and you have inherited it, and He has done you good, and multiplied you above your fathers.
30.6: `And Jehovah your God has circumcised your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love Jehovah your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, for the sake of your life;
30.7: and Jehovah your God has put all this oath on your enemies, and on those hating you, who have pursued you.
30.8: `And you do turn back, and have hearkened to the voice of Jehovah, and have done all His commands which I am commanding you to-day;
30.9: and Jehovah your God has made you abundant in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Jehovah turns back to rejoice over you for good, as He rejoiced over your fathers,
30.10: for you do hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God, to keep His commands, and His statutes, which are written in the book of this law, for you turn back to Jehovah your God, with all your heart, and with all your soul.
30.11: `For this command which I am commanding you to-day, it is not too wonderful for you, nor is it far off.
30.12: It is not in the heavens, --saying, Who does go up for us into the heavens, and does take it for us, and does cause us to hear it--that we may do it.
30.13: And it is not beyond the sea, --saying, Who does pass over for us beyond the sea, and does take it for us, and does cause us to hear it--that we may do it?
30.14: For very near to you is the word, in your mouth, and in your heart--to do it.
30.15: `See, I have set before you to-day life and good, and death and evil,
30.16: in that I am commanding you to-day to love Jehovah your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commands, and His statutes, and His judgments; and you have lived and multiplied, and Jehovah your God has blessed you in the land where you are going in to possess it.
30.17: `And if your heart does turn, and you do not hearken, and have been driven away, and have bowed yourself to other gods, and served them,
30.18: I have declared to you this day, that you do certainly perish, you do not prolong days on the ground which you are passing over the Jordan to go in there to possess it.
30.19: `I have caused to testify against you to-day the heavens and the earth; life and death I have set before you, the blessing and the reviling; and you have fixed on life, so that you do live, you and your seed,
30.20: to love Jehovah your God, to hearken to His voice, and to cleave to Him (for He is your life, and the length of your days), to dwell on the ground which Jehovah has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them.'

31.1: And Moses goes and speaks these words to all Israel,
31.2: and he says to them, `A son of a hundred and twenty years am I to-day; I am not able any more to go out and to come in, and Jehovah has said to me, You do not pass over this Jordan,
31.3: `Jehovah your God He is passing over before you, He does destroy these nations from before you, and you have possessed them; Joshua--he is passing over before you as Jehovah has spoken,
31.4: and Jehovah has done to them as he has done to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorite, and to their land, whom He destroyed.
31.5: And Jehovah has given them before your face, and you have done to them according to all the command which I have commanded you;
31.6: be strong and courageous, fear not, nor be terrified because of them, for Jehovah your God is He who is going with you; He does not fail you nor forsake you.'
31.7: And Moses calls for Joshua, and says to him before the eyes of all Israel, `Be strong and courageous, for you--you do go in with this people to the land which Jehovah has sworn to their fathers to give to them, and you--you do cause them to inherit it;
31.8: and Jehovah is He who is going before you, He himself is with you; He does not fail you nor forsake you; fear not, nor be affrighted.'
31.9: And Moses writes this law, and gives it to the priests (sons of Levi, those bearing the ark of the covenant of Jehovah), and to all the elders of Israel,
31.10: and Moses commands them, saying, `At the end of seven years, in the appointed time, the year of release, in the feast of booths,
31.11: in the coming in of all Israel to see the face of Jehovah in the place which He chooses, you do proclaim this law before all Israel, in their ears.
31.12: `Assemble the people, the men, and the women, and the infants, and your sojourner who is within your gates, so that they hear, and so that they learn, and have feared Jehovah your God, and observed to do all the words of this law;
31.13: and their sons, who have not known, do hear, and have learned to fear Jehovah your God all the days which you are living on the ground where you are passing over the Jordan to possess it.'
31.14: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Indeed, your days have drawn near to die; call Joshua, and station yourselves in the tent of meeting, and I charge him;' and Moses goes--Joshua also--and they station themselves in the tent of meeting,
31.15: and Jehovah is seen in the tent, in a pillar of a cloud; and the pillar of the cloud stands at the opening of the tent.
31.16: And Jehovah says to Moses, `Indeed, you are lying down with your fathers, and this people has risen, and gone a-whoring after the gods of the stranger of the land into the midst of which it has entered, and forsaken Me, and broken My covenant which I made with it;
31.17: and My anger has burned against it in that day, and I have forsaken them, and hidden My face from them, and it has been for consumption, and many evils and distresses have found it, and it has said in that day, Is it not because that my God is not in my midst--these evils have found me?
31.18: and I certainly hide My face in that day for all the evil which it has done, for it has turned to other gods.
31.19: `And now, write for you this song, and teach it the sons of Israel; put it in their mouths, so that this song is to Me for a witness against the sons of Israel,
31.20: and I bring them in to the ground which I have sworn to their fathers--flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten, and been satisfied, and been fat, and have turned to other gods, and they have served them, and despised Me, and broken My covenant.
31.21: `And it has been, when many evils and distresses do meet it, that this song has testified to its face for a witness; for it is not forgotten out of the mouth of its seed, for I have known its imagining which it is doing to-day, before I bring them in to the land of which I have sworn.'
31.22: And Moses writes this song on that day, and does teach it the sons of Israel,
31.23: and He commands Joshua son of Nun, and says, `Be strong and courageous, for you do bring in the sons of Israel to the land which I have sworn to them, and I--I am with you.'
31.24: And it comes to pass, when Moses finishes to write the words of this law on a book till their completion,
31.25: that Moses commands the Levites bearing the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, saying,
31.26: `Take this Book of the Law, and you have set it on the side of the ark of the covenant of Jehovah your God, and it has been there against you for a witness;
31.27: for I--I have known your rebellion, and your stiff neck; indeed, in my being yet alive with you to-day, rebellious you have been with Jehovah, and also surely after my death.
31.28: `Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes, and your authorities, and I speak in their ears these words, and cause to testify against them the heavens and the earth,
31.29: for I have known that after my death you do very corruptly, and have turned aside out of the way which I commanded you, and evil has met you in the latter end of the days, because you do the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to make Him angry with the work of your hands.'
31.30: And Moses speaks in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, till their completion: --

32.1: `Give ear, O heavens, and I speak; And you do hear, O earth, sayings of my mouth!
32.2: Drop as rain does My doctrine; Flow as dew does My sayings; As storms on the tender grass, And as showers on the herb,
32.3: For the Name of Jehovah I proclaim, Ascribe you greatness to our God!
32.4: The Rock! --perfect is His work, For all His ways are just; God of stedfastness, and without iniquity: Righteous and upright is He.
32.5: It has done corruptly to Him; Their blemish is not His sons', A generation perverse and crooked!
32.6: To Jehovah do you act thus, O people foolish and not wise? Is not He your father--your possessor? He made you, and does establish you.
32.7: Remember days of old--Understand the years of many generations--Ask your father, and he does tell you; Your elders, and they say to you:
32.8: In the Most High causing nations to inherit, In His separating sons of Adam--He sets up the borders of the peoples By the number of the sons of Israel.
32.9: For Jehovah's portion is His people, Jacob is the line of His inheritance.
32.10: He finds him in a land--a desert, And in a void--a howling wilderness, He turns him round--He causes him to understand--He keeps him as the apple of His eye.
32.11: As an eagle wakes up its nest, Over its young ones flutters, Spreads its wings--takes them, Bears them on its pinions; --
32.12: Jehovah alone does lead him, And there is no strange god with him.
32.13: He makes him ride on high places of earth, And he eats increase of the fields, And He makes him suck honey from a rock, And oil out of the flint of a rock;
32.14: Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, and rams, sons of Bashan, And he-goats, with fat of kidneys of wheat; And of the blood of the grape you do drink wine!
32.15: And Jeshurun waxes fat, and does kick: You have been fat--you have been thick, You have been covered. And he leaves God who made him, And dishonours the Rock of his salvation.
32.16: They make Him zealous with strangers, With abominations they make Him angry.
32.17: They sacrifice to demons--no god! Gods they have not known--New ones--from the vicinity they came; Not feared them have your fathers!
32.18: The Rock that begat you you forget, And neglect God who forms you.
32.19: And Jehovah sees and despises--For the provocation of His sons and His daughters.
32.20: And He says: I hide My face from them, I see what is their latter end; For a froward generation are they, Sons in whom is no stedfastness.
32.21: They have made Me zealous by `no-god,' They made Me angry by their vanities; And I make them zealous by `no-people,' By a foolish nation I make them angry.
32.22: For a fire has been kindled in My anger, And it burns to Sheol--the lowest, And consumes earth and its increase, And sets on fire foundations of mountains.
32.23: I gather upon them evils, My arrows I consume upon them.
32.24: Exhausted by famine, And consumed by heat, and bitter destruction. And the teeth of beasts I send upon them, With poison of fearful things of the dust.
32.25: Without bereave does the sword, And at the inner-chambers--fear, Both youth and virgin, Suckling with man of grey hair.
32.26: I have said: I blow them away, I cause their remembrance to cease from man;
32.27: If not--the anger of an enemy I fear, Lest their adversaries know--Lest they say, Our hand is high, And Jehovah has not worked all this.
32.28: For a nation lost to counsels are they, And there is no understanding in them.
32.29: If they were wise--They deal wisely with this; They attend to their latter end:
32.30: How does one pursue a thousand, And two cause a myriad to flee! If not--that their rock has sold them, And Jehovah has shut them up?
32.31: For not as our Rock is their rock, (And our enemies are judges!)
32.32: For of the vine of Sodom their vine is, And of the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes are grapes of gall--They have bitter clusters;
32.33: The poison of dragons is their wine And the fierce venom of asps.
32.34: Is it not laid up with Me? Sealed among My treasures?
32.35: Mine are vengeance and recompense, At the due time--does their foot slide; For near is a day of their calamity, And haste do things prepared for them.
32.36: For Jehovah does judge His people, And for His servants does repent Himself. For He sees--the going away of power, And none is restrained and left.
32.37: And He has said, Where are their gods--The rock in which they trusted;
32.38: Which the fat of their sacrifices do eat, They drink the wine of their libation! Let them arise and help you, Let it be for you a hiding-place!
32.39: See you, now, that I--I am He, And there is no god with Me: I put to death, and I keep alive; I have smitten, and I heal; And there is not from My hand a deliverer,
32.40: For I lift up to the heavens My hand, And have said, I live--to the age!
32.41: If I have sharpened the brightness of My sword, And My hand does lay hold on judgment, I turn back vengeance to My adversaries, And to those hating Me--I repay!
32.42: I make drunk My arrows with blood, And My sword devours flesh, From the blood of the pierced and captive, From the head of the freemen of the enemy.
32.43: Sing you nations-- with his people, For the blood of His servants He avenges, And vengeance He turns back on His adversaries, And has pardoned His land--His people.'
32.44: And Moses comes and speaks all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Hoshea son of Nun;
32.45: and Moses finishes to speak all these words to all Israel,
32.46: and says to them, `Set your heart to all the words which I am testifying against you to-day, that you command your sons to observe to do all the words of this law,
32.47: for it is not a vain thing for you, for it is your life, and by this thing you prolong days on the ground where you are passing over the Jordan to possess it.'
32.48: And Jehovah speaks to Moses, in this self-same day, saying,
32.49: `Go up to this mount Abarim, mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, which is on the front of Jericho, and see the land of Canaan which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession;
32.50: and die in the mount where you are going up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother has died in the mount Hor, and is gathered to his people:
32.51: `Because you trespassed against me in the midst of the sons of Israel at the waters of Meribath-Kadesh, the wilderness of Zin--because you sanctified Me not in the midst of the sons of Israel;
32.52: but over-against you see the land, and there you do not go in, to the land which I am giving to the sons of Israel.'

33.1: And this is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the sons of Israel before his death,
33.2: and he says: --`Jehovah from Sinai has come, And has risen from Seir for them; He has shone from mount Paran, And has come with myriads of holy ones; At His right hand are springs for them.
33.3: Also He is loving the peoples; All His holy ones are in your hand, And they--they sat down at your foot, Each He lifts up at your words.
33.4: A law has Moses commanded us, A possession of the assembly of Jacob.
33.5: And he is in Jeshurun king, In the heads of the people gathering together, The tribes of Israel!
33.6: Let Reuben live, and not die, And let his men be a number.
33.7: And this is for Judah; and he says: --Hear, O Jehovah, the voice of Judah, And to his people do You bring him in; His hand has striven for him, And an help from his adversaries are You.
33.8: And of Levi he said: --Your Thummim and your Urim are for your pious one, Whom You have tried in Massah, You do strive with Him at the waters of Meribah;
33.9: Who is saying of his father and his mother, I have not seen him; And his brethren he has not discerned, And his sons he has not known; For they have observed Your saying, And Your covenant they keep.
33.10: They teach Your judgments to Jacob, And Your law to Israel; They put perfume in Your nose, And whole burnt-offering on Your altar.
33.11: Bless, O Jehovah, his strength, And the work of his hands You accept, Smite the loins of his withstanders, And of those hating him--that they rise not!
33.12: Of Benjamin he said: --The beloved of Jehovah does tabernacle confidently by him, Covering him over all the day; Yes, between his shoulders He does tabernacle.
33.13: And of Joseph he said: --Blessed of Jehovah is his land, By precious things of the heavens, By dew, and by the deep crouching beneath,
33.14: And by precious things--fruits of the sun, And by precious things--cast forth by the moons,
33.15: And by chief things--of the ancient mountains, And by precious things--of the age-during heights,
33.16: And by precious things--of earth and its fulness, And the good pleasure Of Him who is dwelling in the bush, --Let it come for the head of Joseph, And for the crown of him Who is separate from his brethren.
33.17: His honour is a firstling of his ox, And his horns are horns of a reem; By them peoples he does push together To the ends of earth; And they are the myriads of Ephraim, And they are the thousands of Manasseh.
33.18: And of Zebulun he said: --Rejoice, O Zebulun, in your going out, And, O Issachar, in your tents;
33.19: Peoples to the mountain they call, There they sacrifice righteous sacrifices; For the abundance of the seas they suck, And hidden things hidden in the sand.
33.20: And of Gad he said: --Blessed of the Enlarger is Gad, As a lioness he does tabernacle, And has torn the arm--also the crown!
33.21: And he provides the first part for himself, For there the portion of the lawgiver is covered, And he comes with the heads of the people; The righteousness of Jehovah he has done, And His judgments with Israel.
33.22: And of Dan he said: --Dan is a lion's whelp; he does leap from Bashan.
33.23: And of Naphtali he said: --O Naphtali, satisfied with pleasure, And full of the blessing of Jehovah, West and south possess you.
33.24: And of Asher he said: --Blessed with sons is Asher, Let him be accepted by his brethren, And dipping in oil his foot.
33.25: Iron and brass are your shoes, And as your days--your strength.
33.26: There is none like the God of Jeshurun, Riding the heavens in your help, And in His excellency the skies.
33.27: A habitation is the eternal God, And beneath are arms age-during. And He casts out from your presence the enemy, and says, `Destroy!'
33.28: And Israel does tabernacle in confidence alone; The eye of Jacob is to a land of corn and wine; Also His heavens drop down dew.
33.29: O your happiness, O Israel! who is like you? A people saved by Jehovah, The shield of your help, And He who is the sword of your excellency: And your enemies are subdued for you, And you on their high places do tread.'

34.1: And Moses goes up from the plains of Moab to mount Nebo, the top of Pisgah, which is on the front of Jericho, and Jehovah shows him all the land--Gilead to Dan,
34.2: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah to the further sea,
34.3: and the south, and the circuit of the valley of Jericho, the city of palms, to Zoar.
34.4: And Jehovah says to him, `This is the land which I have sworn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To your seed I give it; I have caused you to see with your eyes, and there you do not pass over.'
34.5: And Moses, servant of the Lord, dies there, in the land of Moab, according to the command of Jehovah;
34.6: and He buries him in a valley in the land of Moab, over-against Beth-Peor, and no man has known his burying place to this day.
34.7: And Moses is a son of a hundred and twenty years when he dies; his eye has not become dim, nor has his moisture fled.
34.8: And the sons of Israel bewail Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; and the days of weeping and mourning for Moses are completed.
34.9: And Joshua son of Nun is full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands upon him, and the sons of Israel hearken to him, and do as Jehovah commanded Moses.
34.10: And there has not arisen a prophet any more in Israel like Moses, whom Jehovah has known face to face,
34.11: in reference to all the signs and the wonders which Jehovah sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
34.12: and in reference to all the strong hand, and to all the great fear which Moses did before the eyes of all Israel.
